chapters.title: Chapter 401: Veyrha, The Twilight Brand (2)
paragraphs: Nara was pulled into the dark clouds, and for six hours, nothing happened until, suddenly, lightning flashed through the sky, and a figure was brought into view.
The moment her silhouette appeared, the true name appeared in Kent’s mind, bringing a smile to his face.
He went ahead and spoke the True Name, "Veyrha, The Twilight Brand."

That was the only thing he said, for that was the only word he received. It was bizarre, but it worked, since the moment he said that, Nara’s eyes snapped open, and a powerful pressure descended from her body.
The pressure is filled with the sense of pure infernal energy. Kent gazed at the image of the lady and smiled again.
She wielded a long black sword.

She was clad in dark silver and black armor that seemed to contain the very essence of darkness. It was strange, for she was inside darkness, or what appeared to be darkness, yet her armor behaved like the true darkness.
Her eyes were dual in hue—one violet, the other ethereal silver—both possessing their own powers. This, of course, gave her a unique appearance, one that made her look very beautiful in all aspects.
She had long, ink-black hair with strands of silver and violet that shimmered whenever the lightning flashed in the clouds behind her.
Behind her was a circular silver light that seemed tattered yet whole. It was hovering behind her as she gazed down at Kent and the other two night riders staring back at her.
Rumble.
Lightning flashed behind her again, and from the clouds, a silhouette of a colossal wraith appeared, but only for a moment.
At that exact moment, far away in a world very distant from Sonox, a shard snapped off a dark star—one that was several million, if not billions, of light-years away—and fell into this world.
The world was Xyra, the land of the stone demons. It was a high world and not a friendly place to visit.
In that very moment, Kent also heard the familiar sound he always got whenever a quest from the universe arrived.
However, he didn’t let it block his view, for he was watching a rather heavy-chested lady fly toward them.
Ironically, when she landed on the ground, those twin melons bounced. Thankfully, Saden and Uncle Drew weren’t as shameless as he, so they simply looked at the pale beauty who had landed.
He, on the other hand, was focused on the twin melons that accompanied her.
’Welcome to the family, you two,’ he smiled, then chose to check the message while the Night Riders reunited.
He wasn’t planning on getting into her business now. That can wait for later, for they have nothing but time on their hands.
⟪This is a notice to inform you that there is an upcoming quest that will help your 4th Night Rider complete her awakening. But you must first complete the universe quest you still have pending.⟫
’Hmm, it wasn’t really a quest,’ Kent sighed.
However, the discovery that Nara hadn’t finished her awakening meant she still had a part of her locked away and wouldn’t be awakened until he received that quest and dealt with it.

’Is this the universe’s way of telling me I should have started that quest already? But I have two more years. That is plenty of time to get it done, considering I wasn’t lazing around but actually beefing up my strength.’
Kent sighed again.
’Fine. Since it’s a quest to save an entire world, I must work on that.’
He sighed for the third time.
If only he knew this was for the best. The SSS-Ranked dungeon had a lot to offer, so clearing it was perhaps the best thing he should focus on now.
He looked toward Nara, who was smiling with Uncle Drew and Saden. It was as if she had reunited with a long-lost family, and he couldn’t help but feel happy for her.
Right now, she needed that.
Her traumatic past cannot linger for long. Somehow, she must let go of her past and let her new life take its course.
"Congratulations on your awakening and breakthrough, Nara. It looks like you’re back to your previous self," Kent said, and Nara smiled.

"This is all thanks to you. I expected many things, but I never expected to suddenly become a Peak Root Transcendent from the Sage stage, awaken terrifying abilities, and..." She looked at the sword in her hand.
"This sword can literally sever the very fabric of reality. If I had this sword back then, I wouldn’t have been reduced to the state I was saved from." She sighed.
"No need to look down. You and I wouldn’t have met if you had had this sword back then. I mean, I wouldn’t have met Nara, and then met you, so in a way, it all worked out well in the end." He smiled.
"So what you mean to say is that I was supposed to suffer so today could happen?" she asked with a sarcastic smile and playful humor.
"Was my suffering your joy and happiness, huh?" She moved like a shadow and appeared before him, bringing those two melons closer for inspection.

Kent just smiled and licked his lips, looking at the two boobies practically asking for his attention. Naturally, Uncle Drew, who knew how shameless his young master was, shook his head as a smile appeared on his face.
Saden, who was new to this, gave her leader an excuse and vanished back to Tower City to spend more time with her Soul Sentinel friends and Li Hua.
Things heated up for a few minutes before Kent cleared his throat.
"Maybe we should clear the darkness so the ladies can see and hear us," Kent said.
For some strange reason, aside from the three of them, when the darkness appeared, the rest of the ladies couldn’t see or hear them.
Nara nodded and waved her sword. The next second, her armor changed into a veiled dress that did nothing to hide her assets.
The darkness too was also cleared.
"Big sister, you have become like them," Mara pouted when she set her sights on Nara. The ’them’ she was talking about was Selene and the ladies who had awakened their True Names.
Naturally, they were all beauties now, and when we say beauty, they had become women who could bring down an empire with just a smile.
"No need to sound jealous, Mara. You’ll become one of them soon. I just have to keep you awake for as long as you can hold on," Kent said, and Mara blushed.
"Then you better hurry up. Some of us can’t wait for long," Nara said teasingly, making Kent shake his head.
But he took it seriously, and like she said, she wouldn’t have to wait for long.

chapters.title: Chapter 402: Going Back to the Underworld
paragraphs: "So, how long will you be away this time around?" Kent asked, standing beside Uncle Drew, who was ready to head back to the Underworld.
For now, he is going to the underworld. After he is done with his business there, he will go back to Hell, where he will create more Hell demons.
The battle in Fedora had been a good harvest for him.
He managed to secure 21 beasts that he could turn into Hell demons—17 Transcendents and 4 Ascension-stage beasts.
This meant that if what happened last time were to repeat itself, he would return with 17 Ascension-stage Hell demons and 4 Sovereign-stage Hell demons.
That is a force one could not look down on. Having just a single sovereign under your command will set you at the peak, and he will get 4.
However, Kent knew from Uncle Drew’s recount that the process wasn’t all rainbows and sunshine, so he asked when he would return.
That way, he would know what to do and what not to do in his absence.
"Time down there moves faster than it does here and in the outside world, so I will be gone for a while—probably between 25 to 50 years.
But if the time difference is anything like this place, then I will be gone for three years tops.
However, I won’t be leaving without putting measures in place.
Nara is my second-in-command. She also has the ability to sense and locate the next rider, so while I’m gone, she will continue to increase our ranks.

But of course, if things hasten, then I will return sooner than you think," Uncle Drew said solemnly. He probably felt guilty about abandoning Kent like this. Though he would be back, it would take a while.
"There’s no need to feel guilty about it, Uncle Drew. Go do what you have to; I’ll be fine." Kent smiled. "There’s Kaizo and the others, so I’ll be fine.
"You, on the other hand, should be careful. Though you have a connection with an Underworld Queen, you cannot blindly trust her.
But even if she is trustworthy, be careful of the other underworld kings and queens.
Be extra careful, or else I will be forced to pop up down there and straighten some people out," Uncle Drew smiled at Kent’s words, if only he knew he meant what he said.
"I will be careful, Young Master," he replied before taking the Underworld Mask and putting it on. "Then, until we meet again."
He took a step, and a dark portal opened. Without hesitation, he stepped in and was gone. Kent sighed the moment he left.
"I really hope you won’t be putting your life on the line for my sake," he muttered before vanishing back toward the harem tower.
However, when Uncle Drew entered, a strange-looking portal appeared atop a windy mountain. The surroundings were calm, yet the eeriness in the air was anything but friendly.
The color of the air wasn’t vibrant either—it looked like a grayscale image.
"I will always prepare the real world for this," he muttered the moment he appeared through the portal.
He looked around him for a few moments before flying away.
Moving at an incredibly fast speed, he headed toward a specific destination. However, it still took him a week to get near his goal.
It was a large black castle.
Everything surrounding it was black—the grass, the trees, the stones used for building the castle, and even the roof.
From afar, it looked majestic, but the danger became apparent when one stepped closer.
Uncle Drew wore his mask and kept flying toward it. When he was just a few meters from the massive gate fencing the building, he stopped.
He looked up ahead and sighed.
At the gate, two large statues of gargoyles stood guard on either side. Uncle Drew halted and looked at them.
Though they were statues, he knew better.
These two gargoyles were among the most dangerous beings in the entire Underworld. Aside from the seven Underworld Kings and six Underworld Queens, these two were also immensely powerful.
Uncle Drew stared at them for a few seconds before speaking to the large gate.
"I am here to visit, my Queen."
Those were the only words worth saying. The gate swung open, and he was pulled inside before it shut behind him.
He reappeared behind another door, which immediately opened to let him in. The moment he stepped through, he found himself in a vast hall, entirely decorated in black.
Looking ahead, an incredibly beautiful woman sat upon a grand yet majestic throne.
Her pale skin contrasted with her long, flowing dark hair, which cascaded behind her like a midnight waterfall. Her presence was welcoming, yet something about her made her unapproachable.
Naturally, if Kent were present, his attention would have been drawn to her chest area, which was packaged well to make anyone, including him, drool.
But even without that, her dark eyes, hair, and painted dark lips made her a beauty mortals could not comprehend. She was that mesmerizing.
"You are here early," she spoke suddenly, her sweet voice intoxicating.

"Indeed. My young master and I had an unexpected adventure, which allowed me to gather a good haul faster than anticipated," Uncle Drew replied, standing his ground despite being in the presence of a demigod.
"This young master of yours sounds interesting. Every time you speak of him... it makes me want to meet him," Nyx, the Queen of the Ninth Level of the Underworld, said.
"Young Master is indeed a unique individual. You will most certainly like him when you meet him."
Uncle Drew said with a smile behind his mask, but inwardly he was probably laughing.
He knew that the moment his young master laid eyes on this beauty, not even the gods could stop him from sinking his fangs into her.
So her wanting to meet Kent was her way of serving herself on a silver platter.
"I do hope so... If not, I will be disappointed," Nyx chuckled—a rare sight—before asking, "How many did you bring this time, and where do you want to go?"
"I brought 21 and would like to go to the Black Castle."
"Are you sure? That place is one of the most dangerous in the Underworld. While you can’t easily die, you’re still below the Sovereign stage... going there will put your life at great risk."
"I will manage, my Queen," Uncle Drew said.
"Very well," Nyx did not argue. She simply waved her hand, conjuring a portal. "I will bring you out when you are done. But if you face a danger there, I can’t help you."
Uncle Drew nodded and stepped into the portal. The moment it closed, a sigh escaped her lips.
"Who are you, and why do I feel obligated to help your subordinate?" The image of Kent appeared on a silver orb resting beside her throne.
"I do hope we meet soon, or else I will be forced to send demons to kidnap you." She sighed again and closed her eyes, entering meditation.
Meanwhile, Uncle Drew appeared in front of a large castle, one that spanned thousands of miles. Inside are some of the most vicious souls in the underworld.
Since he needed souls for his hell demons, he went for where the best and vicious are.

chapters.title: Chapter 408: The Wicked Poison Witch’s Secret {Gift Bonus - }
paragraphs: While Kent was getting intimate with his new wife, the outside world underwent many changes.
First, a week ago, the people camping at the sect’s entrance left because they realized Kent never planned to see them.
Most had come to form alliances, while a few sought the treasures that had belonged to their family members who had gone against Kent.
These people were simply shameless, knowing full well that asking for such things would only invite trouble with Kent.
But he didn’t even bother to acknowledge them, as he never had their treasures to begin with. They had all been sent into the Necro Forge, and the few remaining would follow soon enough.
They can come ask Kaizo and Sylara for them, for their treasures were used to create them. Wouldn’t that be a sight to see?
However, the moment they left, they began plotting how to kill him, unwilling to let him go unscathed. Of course, a few kept track of when he would appear.
If only they knew that the Kent they once feared had become even more terrifying, perhaps they would accept their loss and go cry to their mothers.
Meanwhile, somewhere in Eldorath, the wicked Poison Witch had seated her disciple down for a serious conversation.
"Annabelle, what do you think of that boy, Kent?" she asked. When the words left her lips, Annabelle clenched her fists in anger. Her face revealed that she really hated Kent.
"I will kill him. That bastard dared to disrespect you," she gritted her teeth, but a sudden slap landed on her cheek before she could say another word.
"Are you stupid? Do you want to die?" her master said, making Annabelle frown.
"Master... You..." She didn’t know what to say. This was the first time her master had ever struck her, and from the look in her eyes, she could tell she was serious about it.
"Haven’t you heard what went down between him and the Evil Sect? If you don’t know, then I will tell you," she sighed, her mind drifting back to that battle.
Before that battle, she had planned to use the opportunity to poison Kent if an opening presented itself.
Of course, since his life was linked to her disciple’s, she had only intended to plant the poison. If he somehow managed to survive and later removed the link as he promised, she would kill him.
The seal only prevented her from killing him directly, but others could, and her disciple would remain unharmed, so she had counted on that.
However, things hadn’t gone as she expected. Instead, she witnessed something that made her blood run cold.
"That battle opened my eyes. Do you know that brat singlehandedly killed multiple Transcendents like they were mere bugs?

He slaughtered them, and I couldn’t understand just how. But when he faced off against Evil Bat, the current sect master of the Evil Sect, I realized that if he wanted you and me dead, he could do it effortlessly.
So for your sake and mine, don’t do anything that will bring down his wrath upon us—or worse, on everyone you care about and love, including your family."
Annabelle’s body shuddered at her master’s words. The last thing she wanted was to bring doom on her master and family.
She had heard rumors about the battle between Kent and the Evil Sect but never truly believed them. Now, hearing it from her master, she couldn’t help but wonder—just who could be that monstrous?
"Just stay away from him during the Pill Master Competition. He will also be participating, so do your best to mind your own business.
Once he removes the seal, we will never interact with him again, for that kid is terrifying. He also has powerful aides and a good relationship with the Master of the Silver Leaf Auction House.
We cannot afford to offend them."
"Okay, Master." Annabelle loved her master, so hearing her words, she knew she had to swallow her pride and perhaps never think of Kent again.

But deep down, she also knew she had to get back at him somehow. Hearing that he would be participating in the Pill Master Competition, she decided—at the very least, she would win and rub it in his face once she was free of the seal.
But as if the universe were plotting against her, Annabelle would have a nasty evening when Kent made his presence known as the perfect alchemist.
After Annabelle left, her master sighed.
"What a headache!" she muttered. "I shouldn’t have spoiled her if I knew days like this would come." She sighed again and walked away.
She went to a room and sat in front of a mirror. Her wrinkled reflection stared back at her, showing how tired she was.
A few minutes passed, but she continued to gaze at herself.
After a while, she sighed, closed her eyes, and muttered a few words.
A few seconds later, her body began to change.
A minute later, a new person sat in front of the mirror—a stunning woman completely unlike her previous form.
She now had flowing blue hair and striking blue eyes, and the aura around her had shifted. No longer did she carry the presence of a Root Transcendent stage cultivator.
Instead, it was clear—she was a Root Ascension stage expert, sitting at the peak.
"It’s been so long that I even forgot my own face," she murmured, her voice now different, reflecting the transformation.
The disguise she wore was known to only one person—Kent.
Back then, when she came to kill him at the sect, Kent saw through her deception.
He even looked deeper and realized she wasn’t just wearing a disguise—she was wearing someone else’s skin. That was why he hesitated when he could have killed her.
Pill Saint Riva gazed at her reflection for a few more minutes before taking out a small painting of a woman. A single tear fell from her eyes as she looked at the familiar face.
"Mom..." Her voice was faint but heavy with emotion.
"Soon, I will kill every last one of them, even if it is the last thing I do." Her fists clenched, dark veins surfacing on the back of her hands.
She sighed as she noticed them.
Kent told her she was poisoned, and he had been right. The wicked Poison Witch was only born to become a poison alchemist for one reason—to find a cure for the poison running through her veins.
But even after several decades, she had never succeeded in that endeavor.
This was the only obstacle standing between her and her dream of exacting vengeance on those who had killed her mother and poisoned her.

"I really hope Annabelle does nothing stupid... so I can perhaps ask for his help," she sighed, then transformed back into her wrinkled form and walked away, once again taking on the guise of Pill Saint Riva, the Wicked Poison Witch.

But he didn’t even bother to acknowledge them, as he never had their treasures to begin with.
They had all been sent into the Necro Forge, and the few remaining would follow soon enough.
They can come ask Kaizo and Sylara for them, for their treasures were used to create them.
Wouldn’t that be a sight to see?
However, the moment they left, they began plotting how to kill him, unwilling to let him go unscathed.
Of course, a few kept track of when he would appear.
If only they knew that the Kent they once feared had become even more terrifying, perhaps they would accept their loss and go cry to their mothers.
Meanwhile, somewhere in Eldorath, the wicked Poison Witch had seated her disciple down for a serious conversation.
"Annabelle, what do you think of that boy, Kent?" she asked.
When the words left her lips, Annabelle clenched her fists in anger.
Her face revealed that she really hated Kent.
"I will kill him.
That bastard dared to disrespect you," she gritted her teeth, but a sudden slap landed on her cheek before she could say another word.
"Are you stupid?
Do you want to die?" her master said, making Annabelle frown.
"Master...
You..." She didn’t know what to say.
This was the first time her master had ever struck her, and from the look in her eyes, she could tell she was serious about it.
"Haven’t you heard what went down between him and the Evil Sect?
If you don’t know, then I will tell you," she sighed, her mind drifting back to that battle.
Before that battle, she had planned to use the opportunity to poison Kent if an opening presented itself.
Of course, since his life was linked to her disciple’s, she had only intended to plant the poison.
If he somehow managed to survive and later removed the link as he promised, she would kill him.
The seal only prevented her from killing him directly, but others could, and her disciple would remain unharmed, so she had counted on that.
However, things hadn’t gone as she expected.
Instead, she witnessed something that made her blood run cold.
"That battle opened my eyes.
Do you know that brat singlehandedly killed multiple Transcendents like they were mere bugs?
He slaughtered them, and I couldn’t understand just how.
But when he faced off against Evil Bat, the current sect master of the Evil Sect, I realized that if he wanted you and me dead, he could do it effortlessly.
So for your sake and mine, don’t do anything that will bring down his wrath upon us—or worse, on everyone you care about and love, including your family."
Annabelle’s body shuddered at her master’s words.
The last thing she wanted was to bring doom on her master and family.
She had heard rumors about the battle between Kent and the Evil Sect but never truly believed them.
Now, hearing it from her master, she couldn’t help but wonder—just who could be that monstrous?
"Just stay away from him during the Pill Master Competition.
He will also be participating, so do your best to mind your own business.
Once he removes the seal, we will never interact with him again, for that kid is terrifying.
He also has powerful aides and a good relationship with the Master of the Silver Leaf Auction House.
We cannot afford to offend them."
"Okay, Master." Annabelle loved her master, so hearing her words, she knew she had to swallow her pride and perhaps never think of Kent again.
But deep down, she also knew she had to get back at him somehow.
Hearing that he would be participating in the Pill Master Competition, she decided—at the very least, she would win and rub it in his face once she was free of the seal.
But as if the universe were plotting against her, Annabelle would have a nasty evening when Kent made his presence known as the perfect alchemist.
After Annabelle left, her master sighed.
"What a headache!" she muttered.
"I shouldn’t have spoiled her if I knew days like this would come." She sighed again and walked away.
She went to a room and sat in front of a mirror.
Her wrinkled reflection stared back at her, showing how tired she was.
A few minutes passed, but she continued to gaze at herself.
After a while, she sighed, closed her eyes, and muttered a few words.
A few seconds later, her body began to change.
A minute later, a new person sat in front of the mirror—a stunning woman completely unlike her previous form.
She now had flowing blue hair and striking blue eyes, and the aura around her had shifted.
No longer did she carry the presence of a Root Transcendent stage cultivator.
Instead, it was clear—she was a Root Ascension stage expert, sitting at the peak.
"It’s been so long that I even forgot my own face," she murmured, her voice now different, reflecting the transformation.
The disguise she wore was known to only one person—Kent.
Back then, when she came to kill him at the sect, Kent saw through her deception.
He even looked deeper and realized she wasn’t just wearing a disguise—she was wearing someone else’s skin.
That was why he hesitated when he could have killed her.
Pill Saint Riva gazed at her reflection for a few more minutes before taking out a small painting of a woman.
A single tear fell from her eyes as she looked at the familiar face.
"Mom..." Her voice was faint but heavy with emotion.
"Soon, I will kill every last one of them, even if it is the last thing I do." Her fists clenched, dark veins surfacing on the back of her hands.
She sighed as she noticed them.
Kent told her she was poisoned, and he had been right.
The wicked Poison Witch was only born to become a poison alchemist for one reason—to find a cure for the poison running through her veins.
But even after several decades, she had never succeeded in that endeavor.
This was the only obstacle standing between her and her dream of exacting vengeance on those who had killed her mother and poisoned her.

"I really hope Annabelle does nothing stupid... so I can perhaps ask for his help," she sighed, then transformed back into her wrinkled form and walked away, once again taking on the guise of Pill Saint Riva, the Wicked Poison Witch.

chapters.title: Chapter 409: Zaila’s Mental Health {Gift Bonus - }
paragraphs: "Wow, you really went wild with Kent, huh?" Unity said as the ladies examined Mara’s ass, now looking like she had polished it with red paint.
She went wild with Kent last night, and while she could have stayed and perhaps healed before going out, she wanted to use the yin pool instead.
That would have sped up her healing. She planned to sneak in, knowing they were still in the forest. But that wasn’t what happened, for they were waiting for her when she arrived in the pool.
This meant her sisters were around to check her out, and right now, as they examined her butt, they couldn’t help but smile and wonder what had gone on between her and Kent.
"Tell us, what happened between you two?" Lilian asked.
"Nothing," Mara said, sticking out her tongue as she walked into the pool, making her sisters look at her enviously.
"They clearly did some kinky shit..." Val said with an expression that showed she would be getting some too. She, just like her sisters, had wild fantasies.
Meanwhile, Nara, who was left inside the garden with Zaila simply because they didn’t want to see what the ladies were up to, decided to have a discussion of their own.
"How are you feeling, Zaila?" Nara asked, holding her hand.
"I am fine, big sister Nara. It’s just that I still have nightmares when I sleep. I am trying, but I can’t seem to let go. So I don’t sleep these days.
But don’t tell my master, she will be worried," she sighed.
"Oh, poor you, come here." Nara pulled her in for a hug. Though they were in separate cages back when the sect master held them captive, their relationship grew over the years.
So hearing that she still wasn’t having a good time made her very sad.
"Is there anything I can do to help you?" Nara asked, but Zaila shook her head.
"I just need some time to recover. I know I will be able to recover," she said, and Nara nodded.
She herself would be lying if she said she was already fine. She wasn’t, but she also wasn’t having as hard a time as Zaila.
Her spirit was stronger than hers. It was why she remained calm despite living as a prisoner for 6 decades.
A few meters away from them, Ingrid couldn’t help but let a tear fall from her eyes as she heard the two ladies have a heart-to-heart.
She was a Voidling, so if she didn’t want them to sense her, they wouldn’t unless you looked deeper and had a very powerful divine sense or a thing for the void.
She was keeping her attention on the ladies at the direction of her sisters. They knew the two weren’t really alright despite showing brave faces every day.
So she was keeping her focus on them. But upon hearing about Zaila’s difficulty, she couldn’t help but become emotional.
She vanished and appeared inside the room where Kent was resting and immediately went to hug him.
"What is wrong?" Kent asked, noticing she wasn’t in the right mood.
"It’s Zaila. I don’t think she is still out of the cage," Ingrid said emotionally.
"What do you mean?" Kent asked again.

"She is still having nightmares, Kent. The poor lady is still trapped in that cage, and hearing her speak just now, I don’t think all we did the past days had any effect on her. She is just pretending to be alright but still broken."
Don’t you have another method to help her?" she asked.
Kent took a deep breath upon hearing her words. He knew things wouldn’t be that simple, but he never expected Zaila to still be so trapped in her nightmare.
’Ladies,’ Kent called out to his three cosmic assistants. He held the sobbing Ingrid as he started conversing with them.
⟪I can isolate her traumatic memories and lock them away. This will make her forget all about the trauma she has been through. Of course, that will also make her forget the other lady she was with.
She will forget about the sect master, her trauma, and Lady Nari⟫. Dori proposed.
’Obviously, we are not doing this, so bring new ideas.’ Kent knew that taking away her memories wasn’t a good idea.
He knew how important memories were, so erasing hers wasn’t the most ideal thing to do.
⟪How about letting her go on a slaughter? I’ve seen in most worlds that using killing as therapy helps sometimes.⟫
Dori proposed again, making Kent wonder if she was indeed the infamous Mind Weaver—the most brilliant person in the entire universe.
Her solutions were rather unusual for someone of her status.
⟪Don’t mind her, Master. She is still young.⟫ Akira laughed.
⟪However, I have the best solution. The current Zaila is still living in her nightmare. So why don’t we make that nightmare real and help her navigate through it?
The moment she escapes the nightmare, she will recover from all that trauma.
Gaia can create a space for that, while I will weave the nightmares, and Dori can weave the mechanisms to ensure her mind attunes with the environment.
It will take many years, but the moment she emerges from that nightmare, a new Zaila—one who has conquered her fears—will be born.⟫ Akira proposed.
The moment Kent heard it, he knew it was the best move.
There was just one tiny question.
’How long would she last in the nightmare?’
⟪24 years, 4 months, and 3 days. That is how long she was trapped after being captured, and that is how long she will need to escape her nightmare.
But that will be for her. In here, it will only take 4 years, which is even shorter in the outside world.⟫
’I see. How fast can you get it running?’
⟪A day.⟫
’Then get down to it.’
⟪That will be 10 million Tower Points. Pleasure doing business with you, master⟫, Gaia giggled.
Kent saw his points drop by ten million, making him want to grab her by the ear.
But since they were doing something meaningful with it, he could only let it go.
He rubbed Ingrid’s back and wiped her eyes.
"I will help her, okay? Zaila is one of you, so I wouldn’t neglect her," Kent said.
Ingrid nodded before curling into a ball in his embrace. Before he knew it, she was fast asleep, making him wonder about many things.
Perhaps she was more affected by Zaila’s words and needed sleep to wash the effect away.
Kent let her rest for hours. When she woke up, she didn’t forget to get her dose of his dragon juice before returning to her duties.

chapters.title: Chapter 410: Spending Time with Zaila {Gift Bonus - }
paragraphs: After Ingrid left, Kent remained inside the room for a few more minutes before freshening up. He left to check up on Zaila and Nara.
When he arrived in the garden, the two ladies were going around picking fruits.
"Ladies," Kent approached them with his usual smile, one that no one could ever get enough of.𝙛𝓻𝒆𝒆𝒘𝙚𝓫𝙣𝙤𝒗𝙚𝓵.𝙘𝙤𝙢
"Kent, you are here," Zaila said, noticing him first.
"Oh? Were you expecting me to be somewhere else?" Kent asked.
"No, I just..." Zaila couldn’t say she had expected him to be off having a freak-off with his women.
"She meant to ask why you’re here while your shameless women are over there." Nara, however, was comfortable saying those words.
"Are you perhaps tired of them, so you’ve come looking for fresh blood?" she asked again, giving Kent a sarcastic smile.
"Fresh blood isn’t too bad." He licked his lips, making Zaila arch her eyebrows while Nara just smirked. She was most definitely not as affected as Zaila was.
"I will be stealing Zaila for a few hours if you don’t mind," Kent said to Nara, who nodded and looked at Zaila.
"Scream if he tries anything funny. I’ll be there before you know it." Both Kent and Zaila couldn’t help but laugh. Nara was just too comfortable with herself despite her past.
"Then I’ll be taking her away now." Kent held Zaila’s hand and vanished from the garden.
After they were gone, Nara sighed.
"You can stop hiding, Ingrid. I know you’re here, so just come out." Ingrid appeared with a guilty smile.
"I’m Sorry. The ladies thought keeping an eye on you would be a good idea since you both went through such a traumatic experience," Ingrid said with her head down.

"No need to apologize. Zaila did need an extra set of eyes on her, and now that you’ve managed to capture something, I’m sure Kent will find a way to help her because I don’t know how to." Nara sighed.
"Kent will help her. He’s the best," Ingrid smiled.
"Just what has he given you ladies to drink that has turned you all into a bunch of honey-trap shameless vixens?" Nara shook her head.
All the ladies were obsessed with Kent. It was as if he had bewitched them.
She came from a family in which her father had married multiple wives. However, those wives weren’t friendly at all. They constantly tried to backstab one another.
But not Kent women.
They surprisingly supported each other, and the man they all shared was the reason for that unity.
Kent.
He was the man keeping them supportive of each other.
So just what did he give them to make them this submissive?
"It’s white, creamy, abundant, and tastes like milk," Ingrid laughed. "You should ask for some next time you’re alone with him. He wouldn’t mind at all."
Her laughter caused Nara to smirk.
She took another big sigh before going back to picking more fruits.
Ingrid joined her.
Meanwhile, Kent and Zaila arrived at the mountain garden, where a picnic basket had already been placed down, filled with some of the best spirit fruits from the Love Garden.
They settled down on the mat, and Kent gently held her hand.
"Are you comfortable like this?" he asked.
"Yes," Zaila answered with a nod. She looked at the magnificent city and couldn’t help but smile. It always took her breath away.
"In that case, why don’t you tell me about yourself?" Kent asked.
Zaila turned and looked at his face.
"Sister Selene said that if you ever ask for my backstory, I should tell you to share yours first," she said, smiling as she raised an eyebrow, clearly demanding his story first.
Kent just smiled and went ahead to tell her.
"I am from a world far from this one. It’s called Earth, and it’s very small. I’m sure these four kingdoms could fill a large portion of it.
But it’s a beautiful world. There are no cultivators there, so no sword or spear fights. But we have weapons called guns, missiles, and many others that could even kill cultivators.
Back then, I was just a very good movie director," Kent said with a smile.
"What is a movie director?" Zaila asked.

"I’m something like a performer in this world. But my job is to capture those performances and put them together using special tools, allowing others across the world to watch them, also using special tools.
They don’t have to be present before they can see and enjoy it."
Kent smiled. He knew she wouldn’t really understand what he was talking about, so he would have to let Gaia fix that first.
"I don’t really get it, but continue. How is it possible that you are here now?"
"I was killed in the most painful way. But that’s beside the point. My death was a new beginning for me because my past life wasn’t ideal."
"You were one of the best directors, right? So why wasn’t it ideal if you were popular back then?" She knew there was something juicy there.
Kent just smiled and said, "I’ll tell you one of these days, but not today."
Telling her that he couldn’t even use his dick back then would be something he’d regret badly.
Naturally, Zaila would end up telling the other ladies one day, and that would be when he’d realize just how annoying they all were.
"So, I died and appeared in the God Realm, where I met my first wife. Thanks to her, here I am, talking to you."
Zaila nodded and took a bite of a berry. "I would love to see your world someday. Maybe when I become an Immortal, I’ll look for it," she said with a smile.
"That’s a big dream of yours, but don’t worry. With me around, becoming an Immortal is nothing to be concerned about."
"Okay, Sage Kent. I will listen to your wise teachings, my holy sage." Zaila laughed, showing her beautiful white teeth.
"You do know that all those who have made fun of me are currently naked inside the Yin Pool, right? Do you perhaps want to join them?"
Zaila’s smile vanished, and a small pout appeared on her face.
"I will scream if you try anything funny," she said.
For a moment, she and Kent simply stared at each other before bursting into laughter, like two old friends reuniting after years apart.
Zaila forgot her trauma and was basking in the moment.
"Your turn. Tell me about Zaila, the beautiful disciple of the Spear Gate Master."

chapters.title: Chapter 411: Who is Zaila {Gift Bonus - }
paragraphs: Zaila was just a lonely daughter of a hunter.
That was all.

She was lonely for the one she called father, and those she called uncles believed she was better suited to be raised at home and then sold off to some well-off family as a bride to some good-for-nothing young master.
Unfortunately for her, her mother died while giving birth to her.
Her best friend died, and for 15 years, she lived like a kitchen stool.
But as all bad things come to an end, her chance to escape arrived when her father died and her uncles went on the run after offending someone they shouldn’t have.
This was her breakthrough moment, so she ran and never looked back.
But after running for an entire month, her food supply was running out, which called for immediate restocking.
However, she had never thought that far ahead when she ran.
So she chose to steal. This was the best way to keep going until she had run far enough.

However, that day, when she stole fruits from that old lady, her life changed forever. That old lady was a Peak Ascension stage expert trying to comprehend something profound, so she took the form of a mortal.
And when Zaila stole from her, she captured her, for she was able to help her greatly.
Most cultivators seemed to forget their roots the moment the years started passing by. So little moments like this were a thing of the past for most.
But that moment changed the cultivator’s life.
So instead of punishing her, she took her to a weapon store and asked her to pick a weapon of her choice.
She had never held a weapon before, but the moment her eyes landed on the spear, she knew it was the one she wanted.
Thus, her journey as a cultivator began at the age of 15. She spent five years with this cultivator until one day, the woman vanished—never to be heard from again.
By then, Zaila had grown to the stage where she could make ends meet.

She became a guard for merchants and took on various jobs just to buy cultivation resources, determined to keep growing in the hope that she would one day meet the mysterious cultivator who had helped her.
But after twelve years alone, she knew she would never meet her again. So, she chose to join a noble family as a guard and became the protector of a certain spoiled heir.
That was where Camilla came in.
On one fateful day, while escorting her young master on a shopping spree, she met the woman who would bring love and joy into her life.
Camilla was the mother she never had.
The big sister she so desperately craved.
The reminder of the mysterious cultivator who had once helped her.
Their meeting wasn’t a friendly one, but their bond quickly deepened, and for years, she was truly happy. But all of that changed when the sect master came into the picture.

"Master Camilla was my idol, my mother, my big sister. She was my everything. So while locked down there, the only thing that kept me going every single day was the thought of her and the hope that I would see her again.
And now I have," Zaila said, squeezing Kent’s hand so hard it would have broken a few bones if he were still a Sage.
"And now that you’ve managed to see her again, how do you feel?" Kent asked, watching her expression shift to the calm demeanor of a serene officer.
"I am happy. Very happy," she said with a smile. However, the look in her eyes told a different story.
"I am happy. But I can’t seem to escape my nightmares." Her tears started falling. "I should be happy. I should be free. I should finally be reunited with my master."
But I can’t seem to escape that nightmare, and it’s breaking my spirit." Her sobbing filled the mountaintop as Kent gently rested her head on his chest and let her cry her tears out.
That much, she had the right to do.
So she spent a good hour pouring her heart out, soaking the caring dragon’s chest. Not that he minded. After spending many nights with his ladies, he had learned how to care for women to some extent.
Right now, Zaila was vulnerable, so all he could do was offer her a shoulder to lean on.
Or, in this case, a chest to cry on. His ladies would be proud of him if they saw him at the moment caring for Zaila.
The lady sitting at the core of the universe most certainly was proud of him.
"Sorry about that," Zaila said with a flustered expression when she finally recovered and noticed the mess she had made.
"No need for that. I chose to ask, so the least I can do is let you shed your tears." Kent smiled.
"However, you don’t have to worry too much about your nightmares. I have a way to help you, so just relax for now."
"Really?" Zaila’s eyes brightened as she moved closer to Kent and held his hand. They were closer than one might expect.
"Indeed. I have a way to help you, so for now, relax and enjoy this picnic while you tell me more about yourself." Kent pulled her closer, letting her rest her head on his shoulder.
He picked a strawberry and slowly placed it in her mouth. This gesture caused her to blush.
"We can start with why you thought stealing was the best move to keep going while on the run." Kent couldn’t help but laugh, making Zaila blush even more.
She most definitely regretted pouring her heart out to him now. But the deed was already done, and as such, she could only blame herself.
So she just rested her head on his shoulder and let Kent tease her for two straight hours. By the time he was done, she had momentarily forgotten the traumatic experience she had suffered.
Kent noticed she was having fun, so he never stopped making her smile and laugh.
After hours on the mountaintop, night fell, and the stars appeared. Kent bought a flying boat from the tower shop and took her on a slow flight across the landscape.
It was a rather romantic evening for the two. When they had had enough of flying around, they returned to the mountain garden, where Zaila eventually fell asleep in Kent’s arms.
In the end, he chose to stay with her, pushing back his night with Camilla—who was happy to hold herself back if it meant her disciple could enjoy herself.

paragraphs: "Master, are we going on a mission?" Kaizo asked the moment Kent arrived at the Legion Tower. It appeared he had finished his morning training.
"No. The mission won’t be for another year or so," Kent replied, making Kaizo sigh.
"Very well, I will wait for that day." He moved away. Kent just smiled. He had created his personality, so he knew the brute always wanted to be in a fight.
’If he’s lucky, he’ll get some action during the Pill Master Competitions.’ Kent didn’t even want to think about that, knowing those people were shameful for targeting a harmless kid.
"Glad to see you’re still enjoying the blood," Kent said to Sylara, who was drinking blood. This was the loot she had gathered from the battle when they went to Fedora.
They were all Root Ascension and Transcendent stage beasts, so she particularly enjoyed herself.
"I could always go for dragon blood if Master doesn’t mind." Kent just ignored her words, knowing that although she sounded normal now, this lady was evil.
What she did to that poor Root Sovereign Stage Orc was a testament to her cruelty.
"Veydris is still not speaking, huh?" Kent smiled and moved to a spot, opening the portal to the Necro Forge. The moment it opened, Gaia, Akira, and Dori appeared.
"Typical," Kent smirked, and then they entered. The moment they arrived inside the forge, their gaze landed on an eight-meter-tall mountain of a man.
"Damn, Akira, where did you get such an idea from?" Kent asked, knowing this mountain of a man had been created using the Undead Schematic Creator.
She designed him from scratch.
"An artist doesn’t disclose her secrets," Akira giggled. Kent just looked at her for a moment before returning his gaze to the towering figure.
"Tell me he can reduce his size," Kent muttered. "Vaelros, can you come down so we short peasants can talk face-to-face with you?"
Since he was the master of the forge, he automatically knew the newcomer’s name and titles. They hadn’t set a name, but the one given was to his liking, so he chose to keep it.
The one before him, though a Peak Root Ascension stage expert like Sylara, possessed an aura alone strong enough to crush anyone below the Root Sovereign stage.
Just staring up at him felt suffocating.
Vaelros nodded and shrank until he was two meters tall. Still, Kent felt like a child before him, though he was now less imposing.

Vaelros was a unique one. He was extremely muscular, built like a god of war. His arms were thick enough to squeeze the life out of anyone, and judging by his expression, he would enjoy doing just that.

He had pale white skin with dark red, glowing cracks running across it, perfectly designed as if his body were containing raw energy. The design was elegant—worthy of being crafted by a cosmic weaver.
Akira had poured her heart into the design. His crimson, glowing eyes were so intense that even Kent found it difficult to look at them directly.
Naturally, Akira and her sisters stood behind him, laughing inwardly. This was their doing.
Vaelros was already demonic-looking, so giving him such an evil personality was something they really shouldn’t have done.
[Intimidation]
That was the personality trait affecting Kent now.
"Hey, dude, I am your boss, okay? So while the intimidation is working, just know that if I unleash my dragon side now, you’ll be running to your mama in tears."
Even Kent laughed at his own words. He might be the Chaos Dragon, but since the universe was on Akira’s side, Vaelros had managed to intimidate him for a few seconds.
But when that intimidation faded, Kent’s gaze landed on the thick, curved black horns protruding from Vaelros’s forehead, further enhancing his demonic appearance.
’Very intimidating. Just what was Akira thinking when she designed him?’ Kent wondered.
Vaelros has white hair that flows down his shoulders. Tying it in a ponytail would suit him well. His body was littered with arcane, blood-red tattoos.
His hands were large and clawed, capable of tearing through steel. From the waist down, he was wrapped in a loose white battle cloth, tied by an infernal sash decorated with metallic skull emblems.
"So, what can you tell me about yourself?" Kent asked.
"I am built for battle. So whenever there is a fight, don’t hesitate to call me. I don’t care how large or how dangerous."
"That is noble of you." Kent laughed. "I mean, do you have any hobbies?"𝚏𝗿𝗲𝐞𝐰𝚎𝕓𝐧𝚘𝘃𝗲𝐥.𝐜𝚘𝕞
"Indeed. I love to fight, kill, and slaughter."
"Bruh." Kent turned and looked at Akira, who smiled and gave him the ’You get what you get’ look.
"Never mind. Then can you tell me what you need to keep growing?" Since this brute had no real hobbies—just like his other teammates—he wouldn’t bother asking again.
Killing wasn’t a hobby.

If a being considered it as one, then he might just be recruiting freaks into his legion. First, there was Kaizo, who was always hungry for battle. Then Sylara, who took joy in torturing her opponents.
And now, there was Vaelros.
"I can grow stronger by consuming the bodies of my kills—their flesh, blood, and core. But just their heart is enough for me."
"I see. You and Sylara will have to come to an agreement on the blood part. Just don’t kill each other during the negotiation."
Kent didn’t bother with anything else and instead focused on Vaelros’s personality traits.
Domineering
Cunning
Loyal
Battle-Hungry
Merciless
Cold & Calculating
Intimidation
These were his defining qualities. Aside from loyalty, none of them were what one would call good traits for a person to have.
Kent took one last look at Vaelros before sending him away to meet the others.
Vaelros was a behemoth like none other. Though he has Lightning and Abyssal affinity, making his connection to blood run deep.
Unlike Kaizo, who relied on his fists, Vaelros wielded chains. A colossal chain served as his weapon—one that expanded and contracted at his command.
From what Kent had read, he even possessed a berserk-type skill that could transform him into a tyrant of raw power when activated.
The cost? An intense hunger for blood. But that could easily be managed.
With Vaelros sent away, Kent was ready to create the fourth undead.

’If he’s lucky, he’ll get some action during the Pill Master Competitions.’ Kent didn’t even want to think about that, knowing those people were shameful for targeting a harmless kid.
"Glad to see you’re still enjoying the blood," Kent said to Sylara, who was drinking blood.
This was the loot she had gathered from the battle when they went to Fedora.
They were all Root Ascension and Transcendent stage beasts, so she particularly enjoyed herself.
"I could always go for dragon blood if Master doesn’t mind." Kent just ignored her words, knowing that although she sounded normal now, this lady was evil.
What she did to that poor Root Sovereign Stage Orc was a testament to her cruelty.
"Veydris is still not speaking, huh?" Kent smiled and moved to a spot, opening the portal to the Necro Forge.
The moment it opened, Gaia, Akira, and Dori appeared.
"Typical," Kent smirked, and then they entered.
The moment they arrived inside the forge, their gaze landed on an eight-meter-tall mountain of a man.
"Damn, Akira, where did you get such an idea from?" Kent asked, knowing this mountain of a man had been created using the Undead Schematic Creator.
She designed him from scratch.
"An artist doesn’t disclose her secrets," Akira giggled.
Kent just looked at her for a moment before returning his gaze to the towering figure.
"Tell me he can reduce his size," Kent muttered.
"Vaelros, can you come down so we short peasants can talk face-to-face with you?"
Since he was the master of the forge, he automatically knew the newcomer’s name and titles.
They hadn’t set a name, but the one given was to his liking, so he chose to keep it.
The one before him, though a Peak Root Ascension stage expert like Sylara, possessed an aura alone strong enough to crush anyone below the Root Sovereign stage.
Just staring up at him felt suffocating.
Vaelros nodded and shrank until he was two meters tall.
Still, Kent felt like a child before him, though he was now less imposing.
Vaelros was a unique one.
He was extremely muscular, built like a god of war.
His arms were thick enough to squeeze the life out of anyone, and judging by his expression, he would enjoy doing just that.
He had pale white skin with dark red, glowing cracks running across it, perfectly designed as if his body were containing raw energy.
The design was elegant—worthy of being crafted by a cosmic weaver.
Akira had poured her heart into the design.
His crimson, glowing eyes were so intense that even Kent found it difficult to look at them directly.
Naturally, Akira and her sisters stood behind him, laughing inwardly.
This was their doing.
Vaelros was already demonic-looking, so giving him such an evil personality was something they really shouldn’t have done.
[Intimidation]
That was the personality trait affecting Kent now.
"Hey, dude, I am your boss, okay?
So while the intimidation is working, just know that if I unleash my dragon side now, you’ll be running to your mama in tears."
Even Kent laughed at his own words.
He might be the Chaos Dragon, but since the universe was on Akira’s side, Vaelros had managed to intimidate him for a few seconds.
But when that intimidation faded, Kent’s gaze landed on the thick, curved black horns protruding from Vaelros’s forehead, further enhancing his demonic appearance.
’Very intimidating.
Just what was Akira thinking when she designed him?’ Kent wondered.
Vaelros has white hair that flows down his shoulders.
Tying it in a ponytail would suit him well.
His body was littered with arcane, blood-red tattoos.
His hands were large and clawed, capable of tearing through steel.
From the waist down, he was wrapped in a loose white battle cloth, tied by an infernal sash decorated with metallic skull emblems.
"So, what can you tell me about yourself?" Kent asked.
"I am built for battle.
So whenever there is a fight, don’t hesitate to call me.
I don’t care how large or how dangerous."
"That is noble of you." Kent laughed.
"I mean, do you have any hobbies?"𝚏𝗿𝗲𝐞𝐰𝚎𝕓𝐧𝚘𝘃𝗲𝐥.𝐜𝚘𝕞
"Indeed.
I love to fight, kill, and slaughter."
"Bruh." Kent turned and looked at Akira, who smiled and gave him the ’You get what you get’ look.
"Never mind.
Then can you tell me what you need to keep growing?" Since this brute had no real hobbies—just like his other teammates—he wouldn’t bother asking again.
Killing wasn’t a hobby.
If a being considered it as one, then he might just be recruiting freaks into his legion.
First, there was Kaizo, who was always hungry for battle.
Then Sylara, who took joy in torturing her opponents.
And now, there was Vaelros.
"I can grow stronger by consuming the bodies of my kills—their flesh, blood, and core.
But just their heart is enough for me."
"I see.
You and Sylara will have to come to an agreement on the blood part.
Just don’t kill each other during the negotiation."
Kent didn’t bother with anything else and instead focused on Vaelros’s personality traits.
Domineering
Cunning
Loyal
Battle-Hungry
Merciless
Cold & Calculating
Intimidation
These were his defining qualities.
Aside from loyalty, none of them were what one would call good traits for a person to have.
Kent took one last look at Vaelros before sending him away to meet the others.
Vaelros was a behemoth like none other.
Though he has Lightning and Abyssal affinity, making his connection to blood run deep.
Unlike Kaizo, who relied on his fists, Vaelros wielded chains.
A colossal chain served as his weapon—one that expanded and contracted at his command.
From what Kent had read, he even possessed a berserk-type skill that could transform him into a tyrant of raw power when activated.
The cost?
An intense hunger for blood.
But that could easily be managed.
With Vaelros sent away, Kent was ready to create the fourth undead.

chapters.title: Chapter 419: Creating the Fourth Undead, Punishment {Gift Bonus - }
paragraphs: "This one looks almost the same as Vaelros," Kent said, staring at the image of the fourth undead, who also had tattoos on his body and two horns on his forehead.

⟪He indeed looks like Vaelros, but they are two completely different beings. This one has traits of dragons and serpents, so he will possess some draconic and serpentine characteristics.⟫ Akira explained.
"So he is another brute," Kent said with a smile.
⟪No, Master. Initially, I wanted him to be a brute, but we already have two, so this one will be a Warlock—an Eldritch Warlock, one of the ancient warlocks who dominated the universe.
However, this one will be unique simply because you have a Mind Weaver on your team.⟫, Akira said, causing Dori to puff her small chest out.
"Tell me something I should look forward to," Kent said.
He intended to create a Witch Doctor using the Poison Sac he obtained during the auction, so hearing that the next undead would be a Warlock, he wanted to know more.
⟪This undead will have a thing for curses, spells, and runes. Basically, he wouldn’t use any weapons, but fighting him will be very frustrating.
His spells will be random, his curses will be lethal, and his runes will be binding. I can already see him bringing an entire battlefield to its knees, brainwashing them to do his bidding.
And before you frown, I know you hate slavery, so I gave him a personality that will make him despise slavery, meaning he wouldn’t enslave even his foes.
He will just brainwash them and turn them into his puppets—if that makes you comfortable.⟫
Kent just chuckled.
Though he hated slavery, he wasn’t foolish enough to think that people shouldn’t be put on a leash. If killing them was not an option, then brainwashing would do.
"Then what resources are we using this time?" He was bathing in valuable resources now, so he didn’t care how much he spent.
⟪One trillion spirit stones, a large chunk of the Forest King—and this is because soon, you can kill your own Forest King, so don’t be stingy. Aside from that, the Poison Sac will be used here.
Of course, I have extracted the vials you will be giving to the Pill Saint. A part of the Domain Crystal will also be used.
Then, there will also be 24 Root Great Sages, 12 Root Transcendents, 4 Root Ascensions, and one Root Sovereign.⟫
"Then I will be getting a Sovereign this time." Kent smiled, already seeing it happening. Although creating undead costs a lot, he knew this many resources would at least give him a Sovereign.
⟪Indeed. That means you will get your first True Undead.⟫ Dori answered.
"My first True Undead? What about Kaizo and the rest?" He raised an eyebrow.
⟪Don’t get me wrong, Master. Kaizo and the others are undead, but they have yet to awaken their bloodlines, which means they haven’t awakened their True Names.
Undead go through a different evolutionary path. This means that the moment they awaken their bloodlines and True Names, they will truly start walking the path of the undead.
You may not be aware of this, but undead are beings that can grow endlessly since killing them is almost impossible.
However, because of the bloodline and True Name restrictions placed on them, they can’t reach the Immortal stage. They cannot surpass the Life stage, for they are dead.
Dead beings can’t comprehend the Law of Life before becoming immortals.
The highest they can attain is the Empyrean stage.⟫
"But with them having a True Name, that can be solved, right?"
⟪Indeed. This is why you are the perfect master of the undead. With the Tower, all your undead will have their own True Names and bloodlines.⟫
"Aren’t I fortunate?" Kent smiled. He pressed the button, and soon, all the items were added, commencing the creation of his fourth undead.
"Damn, an entire week, huh." Kent shook his head.
"So, the moment Kaizo and the rest reach the Sovereign stage, they will also awaken their True Names, right?" Kent asked.
⟪Yes, Master.⟫
"Great. Why don’t we go celebrate?"
The ladies jumped into the air, cheering in excitement. He opened a portal and stepped out. The three Lolis followed him out
A thunderous boom erupted from one of the training grounds as they appeared in the Legion Tower.
Turning, they saw Kaizo getting up, blood seeping from the corner of his mouth.
"Again!" he shouted and charged at Vaelros, who was bathed in lightning and blood energy, wielding two colossal chains.
"He never learns." Kent shook his head, knowing the brute would never be able to beat his fellow brute, yet he still refused to back down.
⟪He grows stronger from physical beatings too, so it’s more like he’s cultivating.⟫
Kent just shook his head and teleported away. They appeared inside the Mountain Garden.
However, before the ladies could get comfortable, Kent grabbed their small legs and lifted them into the air. A second later, they were hanging upside down by a rope.
Kent smiled, produced three markers, and walked toward them.
⟪Master, what are you doing?⟫ Dori asked in a panicked tone.
"Doing what you did to me, obviously."
When he was inside the enlightenment, they painted his face, which caused his wives to make fun of him. So he is paying them back.
⟪It was Gaia’s idea!⟫ Akira immediately pointed fingers.
⟪You bitch! Wasn’t it our collective idea to decorate Master’s face?!⟫ Gaia glared at her sister.
⟪You are the oldest among the three of us, so you should take responsibility, Sister.⟫ Dori said, making Gaia clench her fists.
⟪We are the same age, you two traitorous bitches!⟫
Gaia would probably find a way to get back at them, and Kent, seeing that, knew exactly what to do.
"They are right, Gaia. You should take responsibility."
The moment Akira and Dori heard that and saw the upside-down smile on their master’s face, they knew they were doomed.
Kent laughed like a maniac as he decorated Gaia’s face. The moment he was done, he ran away, afraid the Cosmic Weaver would trap him somewhere in the cosmos.
Up at the core of the universe, the beautiful lady laughed, clutching her stomach as she watched Kent decorate Gaia’s face.
Her eyes gleamed as she spoke, "I told you he would punish you."
⟪I want revenge. Please, Mother, allow me to lock him away somewhere for a month.⟫
"No. You know he is too precious to me, so I can’t let you do that. If he finds out I gave you the go-ahead, he will punish me too." The woman smiled.
⟪Then allow me to punish these two brats.⟫
She thought for a while and chuckled. "Just don’t make them cry, okay? They are your sisters."
Thus, Queen Gaia was born, and her two servants could only fulfill their duties with painted faces for an entire year.

chapters.title: Chapter 420: Arriving for the Pill Master Competition {Gift Bonus - }
paragraphs: "You look happy," Unity said, brushing her hand through his hair as he lay on her lap.
He was back inside the Harem Tower, now surrounded by his ladies and Nara, who was looking at Val, who couldn’t wait to get that dragon out and suck on it.
"I am happy indeed. I have created my third undead, and the fourth is on the way. This means we now have two Peak Ascension stage undead."
The ladies smiled upon hearing that.
This meant their man was now guarded on all sides.
"Does this mean you will be entering the Ancient Battlefield and passing with Lady Lani?" Lilian asked.
"Yes, and I will be taking you all with me. By then, the rest of you will have awakened your true names, and it will be a family hunting trip.
But before then, we have dozens of dungeons to clear and a world to save."
"I am ready anytime," Neomi said, a glint of battle intent in her eyes.
"I know you are, but since we will be saving an entire world, your sisters should also be ready, don’t you think?" Kent asked, and Neomi nodded.
"So what world are we saving?" Val asked. She was after two things. First, she wanted the harem stamp on her ass, finally joining the harem of crazy women.
Second, she wanted her true name too; this way, she could also become a powerful warrior like her sisters. But above these two, she just wanted that dick in her.
So she asked, knowing her time would come before this world-saving event.
"It is a world outside this one. They once had powerful warriors, but they lost all their strength after a world-shattering battle with a certain ant queen.
Now, they are destined to face an extinction event in the next two years.
So we have two years to save them."
"Then we must make it count. The last thing I want is some idiots destroying a world full of defenseless people," Ingrid, the warrior princess, said.
The war princess, Neomi, nodded. Their determination was that of warriors who sought to protect the weak.
"We will keep them safe, for that is what we are here for."
The ladies nodded at his words. Kent turned and looked at Nara.
"We will get that Bat soon enough. Just wait a few months," Kent said, and Nara nodded.
It was during his battle with Evil Bat that she revealed her sword will, which caught the sect masters’ eye.
Naturally, having a sword will is something that shouldn’t have been possible at her level at that time.
There were many stages in weapon cultivation. After the Sword King stage, one advanced to the Sword Emperor, then Monarch, and finally the Sword Legend stage.
Only upon reaching the Sword Legend stage could one start to sense sword will, something akin to an Immortal’s aura.
From there, they will become Sword Divine or Divine Swordsmen. This can only be possible the moment they started comprehending the sword will.
So, for Nara to possess it while still below the Sword Sage stage was unheard of.
Of course, back then, the sect master hadn’t realized it was sword will. Anyone below the Immortal Worlds wouldn’t be able to tell the difference.
He had merely seen it as divine energy and, as such, kidnapped her. His plan was to use her blood energy to rebuild his cultivation from scratch until he reached the Sovereign stage.
And he had nearly succeeded. Thankfully, Kent had intervened.
"By the way, can you still sense the sword Will you used to have?" Kent asked.
"I can still sense it, but it’s faint. However, after I step into the ranks of a Sword King, it will become much stronger than before," Nara answered.
"What sword stage are you at currently?" Kent asked.
"I am at the peak of the Sword Sage stage. I need two more enlightenments before stepping into the Sword King stage."
"I see. I already have a sword path for you. It just needs a few tweaks before it’s ready. Just give it a few more days."
Gaia was currently working on the last two paths he had prepared for Nara and Zaila. Once they were finished, he would send them there to begin their training.
But before that, he would awaken their true names.
He already had true name tokens prepared for them and plenty more in reserve for future beauties.
Soon, Alina, Mara, Camilla, Val, Nara, and Zaila would receive their true names. Naturally, Kent already knew when to awaken Unity’s true name, and that moment was approaching.
Kent and the ladies continued to enjoy themselves inside the tower.
Meanwhile, in Vastport City, young alchemists and their families began arriving for the Pill Master competition.
This was the only alchemy competition organized every two years by the Queen of the Althea Kingdom, who was also an alchemist.
She was one of the Pill Saints of the kingdom and a formidable soul cultivator.
The Pill Grandmaster competition, on the other hand, occurs once every twenty years. The last one was held eight years ago, so there were still twelve years before the next one.
Since that event was rare, the Pill Master competition was the next best opportunity for alchemists to prove themselves.
Geniuses from all four kingdoms had started arriving, eager for the competition, which was now just a day and a few hours away.
A few of these geniuses had already reached the Grandmaster stage, but because of the competition, they had delayed taking their Pill Upgrade Exams to be officially recognized as Pill Grandmasters.
Some had even undergone enlightenment and awakened powerful soul flames.
They were all vying for the connections they could form with the Pill Saints, who would be judging the competition and the rewards.
The competition was bound to be fierce.
However, the real reason so many people were gathering wasn’t just the competition—it was the announcement that the Perfect Alchemist would be making his appearance.
The allure of forming connections with him was irresistible. Naturally, those who sought to eliminate him before he could rise further had also begun making their moves.
Then there are those who are after Kent.

Kent, who had no idea that some people were already plotting against him simply because of his battle dolls, was focused on something else—he was ready to make his Rude Saintess lover his official wife.
And just like that, the garden would soon be filled with another round of pleasurable noises.
Nara could only retreat to the Yin Pool for the night. Staying any longer would make her do things she wasn’t ready for.
"It’s just you and me now, dear," Val said, jumping in for a kiss.

Thankfully, she held herself back. But Kent knew there was something there. However, since she stopped, it meant it would be a mistake or perhaps dangerous for him to dig deeper.
He would let it slide for now, but he would get answers later. Just now, she was about to reveal something she shouldn’t have.
⟪Talk to you later, Master.⟫
Kent sighed.
Looking at Val, he knew she deserved all the rewards he would be giving her.
Thus, when she was done with Vexthra, an intense marathon began, and for hours, the Saintess was reduced to a moaning saintess who just couldn’t get enough of her man.
By daybreak, she passed out smiling.
That was when Kent stopped and smiled. For a man to cause his woman to pass out from pleasure meant he had accomplished his role as a man.
He lay beside her, and later, when they woke up, they went one more round before going to meet the rest of the ladies.
Kent was about to leave for the Pill Master competition.

sentences.text: In the god realm, Vexthra’s domain...
Vexthra had just finished the latest Chapter of her favorite novel, so she threw her device aside and glared at it.
"Damn cliffhangers," she muttered before leaving her bed to prepare a fruit salad.
Naturally, she had all the items she needed, so she made herself a mouth-watering salad and went back inside.
She dug in, and a few minutes into her eating, an idea popped into her mind.
"This bastard.
When he comes here, I’ll make sure he won’t be able to walk for a year." A wicked smile appeared on her face.
And since she was a being of hatred and resentment, her wicked smile was rather sinister.
"I wonder what he’s doing now." The wicked smile turned into a curious one, so she reached out to Unity, who was akin to her baby sister among all her sisters.
Unity was the first mortal she talked to aside from Kent after she became a god, so she held a special place in her heart.

Also, knowing she couldn’t gain her true name using normal means, she understood that being surrounded by overly powerful and beautiful ladies every day could be overwhelming; she was deeply connected to her alone.
She asked what Kent was doing, and Unity narrated everything to her.
"This bastard.
Won’t he go to that Pill Master Competition?" Vexthra asked.
"He still has time, big sister.
Our man is someone who has a lot of time on his hands," Unity smiled.
"That’s true.
We’re lucky to have him, then," Vexthra smiled, remembering when Kent first made a move on her.
She knew nothing about love back then, so she was just going with the flow.
Of course, she tried to resist, but she couldn’t, for she wasn’t able to muster that resistance against him.
But the moment she accepted him, she discovered something called happiness, despite her Law being that of Hate and Resentment.
"They’re done with the second round, so he’ll be reaching out soon," Unity reported, and Vexthra smiled.
She hurriedly ate her plate of fruit salad and waited.
It didn’t take long for her smile to bloom.
[Hello there, my heartbeat.
I hope you and Unity had a nice chat,] Kent said with a smile, making Vexthra blush.
"You saw her, huh?" Vexthra asked.
[Indeed.
Unity is just too innocent and sweet, so she wasn’t good at sneaking around.] When he saw Unity spying on him, he just laughed, for she was rather cute doing the sneaking.
There is something about that just makes her too cute and innocent.
"Don’t punish her, okay?
Doing so will mean her big sisters will have to step in, and since we wouldn’t want them beating you up, just reward her instead," Vexthra smiled.
"Don’t worry, Unity is a doll.
I wouldn’t want to punish her.
But her reward will leave her panting for breath," Kent laughed, causing Val to blush.
"Hurry and add my sister.
I want to hear her voice," Vexthra demanded.
Kent smiled before telling Gaia to add her.
The moment she was added to the harem, the goddess reached out.
Val could only enter the emotional rollercoaster that all her sisters went through.
Kent took that time to review his gains for this time; he actually felt two new changes.
One is foreign, so he went to check immediately.
⟪Congratulations, Master.
You have added the 11th woman to your harem: Valerie (Val).⟫
⟪You have received an item from the universe: Realm Comprehension Tablet⟫
⟪You have received +110,000 Soul Essence and +6,800 Stat Points.⟫
"My Soul cultivation has finally reached the Tier 10 stage, making me someone akin to a Root Ascension cultivator.
This is great," Kent smiled, but his focus was on the second message.
"I have received an item instead of a skill, and this time straight from the universe."
⟪Congratulations, Master, you have received something grand this time,⟫ Gaia spoke, making Kent immediately summon the item and appraise it.
It was a small golden tablet.
⟪Name: Realm Comprehension Tablet⟫
⟪Grade: Supreme⟫
→ A Supreme tablet imbued with the power of the Dao.𝙛𝓻𝒆𝓮𝒘𝙚𝙗𝒏𝙤𝙫𝓮𝒍.𝓬𝒐𝙢
→ When comprehending your realms in front of it, the chances of you gaining clarity and attaining enlightenment are 100% guaranteed.
