chapters.title: Chapter 424: Going To The Competition
paragraphs: "Kent, you and Sister Nara will be the only ones attending the competition. We want her to spend some time with you, so take only her," Neomi said to Kent, who was sleeping comfortably, letting his ladies have their way with him.
"Are you ladies sure? There is room for everyone, and I know you all want to spend some time with me on the outside," Kent asked, but they shook their heads.
"You will have your hands full with Alina and Nara, so focus on them and the competition. We will be on standby to step in when the fights start."
Neomi answered, already packed and ready for battle. They wouldn’t want their man to fight alone, especially after he told them about the battle they missed when he rescued Dori.
"Plus, you might get lucky with Lady Lani and her Master, so be ready for anything."
Selene, of course, had other plans.

"She is a Kingdom Protector, Selene. At least let Kent grow a little. The chances of him dying from her aura alone are very high. So giving him the idea to chase her is like telling him to poke the hornet’s nest."
Neomi smirked, saying that.
"Please, it’s Kent we are talking about. He is probably putting plans in motion already. Just make room for the first Kingdom Protector." Selene just laughed.
The ladies smirked. But of course, they knew what she said was indeed possible.
Kent had already interacted with the lady and knew she was someone worth watching. Whether he would shoot his shot would depend on whether he had the strength to withstand her beatings.
Selene was just stating facts.
"You ladies are thinking too much. This is a competition I am going to; no need to add so many add-ons to it.
I will just go there, do the competition, and then go pay my goddess a visit in the god realm. Other things can wait."
"Whatever. Just don’t get shameless when you set your eyes on any vixen. We may be accepting, but not all vixens can play with that dick."
The ladies laughed.
"Tsk."
Kent just smirked and spent the night with his ladies, letting each of them get a fill of his dragon juice. Once daybreak came, he was ready to leave with Nara.
"Is the veil really necessary, huh, Sister?" Mara asked, staring at the red-clothed lady who had a red veil on her face.
Her shape in the clothes was already enough to attract attention, so adding a veil was like telling everyone, ’I am a mysterious lady, so look at me’.
"I still don’t want to let anyone know I am alive, so I will go incognito for now." Kent smiled, hearing Nara’s answer.
"Don’t worry too much. Even if they recognize you, they wouldn’t be able to do anything. You are going out with me; these small fries wouldn’t have what it takes to touch even a hair on your head."
They just ignored him and pulled Nara to the side.

"You have to do your best, Sister. You know what he likes, so do that, and you will return smiling," Selene said, and Nara nodded, glancing at the nicely dressed, handsome man she would be going out with.
No lady would hate walking side by side with a handsome bastard like Kent.
After spoiling her mind for a while, they let her leave with Kent, who took her hand. They appeared in Saintess Selene’s residence and quickly made their way out of the sect.
The moment they came out of the sect, Kent retrieved a flying carriage he had bought from the tower shop. When the carriage appeared, all the guards at the entrance started drooling.
It looked majestic.
It’s made of gold and jade, making it gleam as it moves away.
"Isn’t that the disciple of the Saintess who fought with the Evil Sect?" one of the guards asked, watching the carriage fly away.
The other guard thought for a moment and nodded.
"Looks like he changed a little, so I couldn’t recognize him immediately. But that is indeed him. I heard he had angered some very powerful people, and now they’re looking for him."
"Then why is he going out all by himself? Is that lady with him perhaps some big shot?" a guard asked.
"Maybe. But the fact that he is going without an aide means he is confident in his abilities, so who are we to question that?"
"You are right."
They could only sigh and watch the carriage disappear into the horizon, its golden and jade exterior catching the light as it soared gracefully through the sky.
Inside the carriage, Nara looked out the window and smiled.
"It’s been a long time since I saw this," she said, smiling. She used to fly over this place whenever she was going on a mission, so seeing it again was like déjà vu.
"We can visit all the places you want. We have time and a flying carriage, so everything is possible," Kent said, also watching the mountains pass below them.
"Thank you, Kent, but I wouldn’t want to trouble you," Nara said with a smile.
"You will go whether you like it or not, so you better pick the first destination you have in mind," Kent chuckled, making Nara smirk.
"Don’t you know when a lady is being subtle?"

"Why be subtle when you can go wild or go home? Plus, if you’re concerned about my safety, then know that two Peak Root Transcendent are following us, and I’m sure the moment we cross the mountains, they will attack."
"Do you want me to handle it?" Nara asked, already drawing her sword.
"Oh, come on. Though I believe in women’s power, this is not something you should dirty yourself with. I will handle it," Kent smiled and vanished from the carriage.
He appeared in the air 4 km away and stood still.
"I don’t know if you are a friend or foe, but if you don’t come out, I will be forced to take drastic action." Kent wasn’t even done speaking when a light flashed from his side.
He quickly stepped back, evading the attack.
A smirk appeared on his face. He looked to the left and then the right, and his smirk turned to a chuckle.
"Well then, shall we?" The golden sword sheath appeared in his grip, and then he vanished.
The next second, two sword lights flashed, and before the two people hiding could realize what happened, their heads were severed, causing them to fall freely from the air.
Kent appeared where he had vanished from.
"They never learn."
He vanished again and soon was back inside the carriage. Meanwhile, two life crystals shattered somewhere in Roland City, causing a level 6 Sovereign hooded figure to snap his eyes open.
"He is finally out," he muttered coldly.

chapters.title: Chapter 425: Old Friends Meet
paragraphs: "How did it go?" Nara asked Kent the moment he reappeared inside the carriage.
"Let’s just say the one who sent them will know I am finally out," Kent smirked. "Looks like there will be fun to have this time too. Can’t wait"
"We better be prepared then," Nara also smiled.
Though she is one elegant lady, she is also a Night Rider, someone built for battle. So hearing there is fun to be had means she is going to have some killing to do.
"Just don’t get too excited. I have leveled up too fast and would like to check how much stronger I have become, so I will take the lead in the battles."
"Still, my captain told me to protect you, so that is what I am going to do, whether you like it or not." Nara wasn’t backing down.
"Fine. But when they are beating you, don’t come crying to me." He smiled before laying his head on her lap.
"What do you think you are doing?" Nara asked, staring into his beautiful purple eyes.
"Protecting my head, of course. How else are you going to do that if you aren’t close to me?" Kent laughed, having no plans to get back up.
Nara sighs and chooses to let him be his shameless self. Of course, her heartbeat is anything but calm as they fly toward the vast city.
About 30 minutes later, they arrived at the entrance of the city.
Normally, they would be asked to identify themselves since everyone else at the gate was doing so.
However, they let it pass when they set their eyes on the golden carriage.
Someone riding that carriage wouldn’t be someone they would want to question, especially since a big event is happening in the city.
So after they entered, Kent directed them to the Silver Leaf Auction House.
They arrived immediately, and Kent led her inside. The guards at the gate recognized him, so they allowed them to enter.
"It’s good to see you again, Kent. I have been expecting you," Lady Lani said, standing a floor ahead of Kent, with Alina smiling beside her. The two look like goddesses looking down on mere mortals.
Kent lifted his head and smiled.
"It’s Good to see you, too, Lady Lani. I can see you have made progress in your cultivation. Congratulations," Kent smiled and led Nara up.

He held her hand like the gentleman he is—not that he was required to. Nara just allowed him to be himself. After all, she had seen enough to know that the handsome young man beside her was someone he could trust.
Lady Lani led them into one of the VIP rooms and sat across from them. The moment she set her sight on Nara, the air in the room changed.
Naturally, both ladies are sizing each other up, which is funny considering Lady Lani is a Sovereign now and Nara is only a Peak Transcendent.
Alina, who was aware of what was happening, giggled.
"Easy, ladies. Before you rip each other’s clothes off, at least get to know each other first," Kent smiled, feeling the air had cleared up.
He knew what had just happened, or at least he thought he knew, but he just couldn’t understand why that had happened.
It wasn’t like he had made any advances that suggested otherwise toward Lady Lani, so why was she sizing Nara up?

Not that he cared. To him, this was a positive outcome, and Alina, who could tell the mischief in Kent’s eye, could only smile and pity the two ladies who didn’t know that they had already fallen into a trap that couldn’t be escaped.
"Nara, this is Lady Lani. She is the master of this auction house, and as you can sense, a Sovereign," Kent introduced Lady Lani to Nara.
"Lady Lani. This is—"
"Nara Ferrychild, also known as Scarlet Sword," Lady Lani said before Kent could finish his sentence.
"You were supposed to be dead," she said curiously.
"And you were supposed to be trapped in that cave," Nara also said.
"I escaped," Lady Lani muttered with a smirk behind her veil.
"I also resurrected," Nara replied with the same smirk on her lips.
"I could swear your death made me smile, and I even celebrated for an entire year," Lady Lani said again.
"I would have celebrated if you were still trapped in that cave, but I guess your annoying luck stepped in. How disappointing," Nara said with a small laugh.
"Good to see you again, Nara. I missed you."
"I don’t," Nara just chuckled.
"Don’t tell me you are still mad about that mission. It was your bad luck for going against me," Lady Lani laughed.
"Bitch... Stealing someone’s kill is as shameless as one can be. I never pegged you to be that shameless," Nara scoffed, showing a disdainful expression.
"Oh please, I killed that beast using my two hands and daggers. Don’t make things up."

The two ladies continued to bicker, leaving Kent in a state of shock. Just now, he sensed their rivalry, thinking it was because of him, but hearing them curse and plot against each other was just too unexpected.
His ego was hit here, and he could feel it.
"What in the tupak world is going on here?" Kent couldn’t help but ask.
"Kent, you better distance yourself from this vixen. I am warning you, she is poisonous," Nara said, glaring at Lady Lani.
"Says the vixen herself. Kent, you better distance yourself from her instead. She will bring you more trouble than luck."
"Tsk... Let’s walk out now and see whether you can keep running your mouth," Nara said, radiating battle intent.
"You are forgetting something, Nara; I am now a Sovereign. Do you really think you can hold your own against me?" Lady Lani laughed, looking at the squint that appeared in Nara’s eye.
"Tsk, annoying bitch," Nara knew Lady Lani won this one, so she backed down. She indeed is a Sovereign, so thinking she could defeat her will not be easy.
Kent looked at the two ladies and knew they were not enemies. No, they are friends who are rivals. The aura between them did not suggest they wanted to rip each other apart.
Instead, they compare themselves against each other as if to measure their finest qualities. This suggests that their rivalry goes way back.
That killing intent wasn’t there.
It was more like friendship-type bickering done by two drop-dead gorgeous people.
"Well, who is explaining?" he asked, and Lady Lani looked at Nara and smiled.
"Nara and I were once best friends, until she died on me. So don’t mind our bickering; she just missed me too much, and while she is hateful and annoying, I couldn’t help but miss her too.
Just take two best friends who hate each other because one is insecure about losing. Naturally, that is Nara here."
Nara smirked behind her veil.
"That is actually very sweet," Kent said with a smile. "Nara, you never told me you and Lady Lani are friends," Kent asked, but Nara just scoffed.
"Who would want to be friends with this hateful vixen?"
Kent could only laugh...and shake his head.

How disappointing," Nara said with a small laugh.
"Good to see you again, Nara.
I missed you."
"I don’t," Nara just chuckled.
"Don’t tell me you are still mad about that mission.
It was your bad luck for going against me," Lady Lani laughed.
"Bitch...
Stealing someone’s kill is as shameless as one can be.
I never pegged you to be that shameless," Nara scoffed, showing a disdainful expression.
"Oh please, I killed that beast using my two hands and daggers.
Don’t make things up."
The two ladies continued to bicker, leaving Kent in a state of shock.
Just now, he sensed their rivalry, thinking it was because of him, but hearing them curse and plot against each other was just too unexpected.
His ego was hit here, and he could feel it.
"What in the tupak world is going on here?" Kent couldn’t help but ask.
"Kent, you better distance yourself from this vixen.
I am warning you, she is poisonous," Nara said, glaring at Lady Lani.
"Says the vixen herself.
Kent, you better distance yourself from her instead.
She will bring you more trouble than luck."
"Tsk...
Let’s walk out now and see whether you can keep running your mouth," Nara said, radiating battle intent.
"You are forgetting something, Nara; I am now a Sovereign.
Do you really think you can hold your own against me?" Lady Lani laughed, looking at the squint that appeared in Nara’s eye.
"Tsk, annoying bitch," Nara knew Lady Lani won this one, so she backed down.
She indeed is a Sovereign, so thinking she could defeat her will not be easy.
Kent looked at the two ladies and knew they were not enemies.
No, they are friends who are rivals.
The aura between them did not suggest they wanted to rip each other apart.
Instead, they compare themselves against each other as if to measure their finest qualities.
This suggests that their rivalry goes way back.
That killing intent wasn’t there.
It was more like friendship-type bickering done by two drop-dead gorgeous people.
"Well, who is explaining?" he asked, and Lady Lani looked at Nara and smiled.
"Nara and I were once best friends, until she died on me.
So don’t mind our bickering; she just missed me too much, and while she is hateful and annoying, I couldn’t help but miss her too.
Just take two best friends who hate each other because one is insecure about losing.
Naturally, that is Nara here."
Nara smirked behind her veil.
"That is actually very sweet," Kent said with a smile.
"Nara, you never told me you and Lady Lani are friends," Kent asked, but Nara just scoffed.
"Who would want to be friends with this hateful vixen?"
Kent could only laugh...and shake his head.

chapters.title: Chapter 426: Meeting Protector Vari Again
paragraphs: Long before Nara was presumed dead, she was best friends with Lady Lani, who back then was a disciple of the Shadow Haven Assassin Sect. One of the top ten sects on the human continent.
It’s the top sect in the Kyrrith Kingdom.
She was a rising star, just like Nara was.
They became friends when Nara won the sect competition after battling her for two hours before the winner was determined.
Since then, they’ve done missions together, and through that, their rivalry was born from the countless battles they fought.
On the surface, they are rivals, but they are best friends behind closed doors.
When Nara died, it broke her.
For an entire year, she never drew her dagger. She only picked it up when Protector Vari picked her as her hidden disciple.
Naturally, her master, who is a Kingdom Protector, knew what had happened to Nara, but like the other protectors, she chose not to concern herself with individual matters.
It was the rule between the Protectors to ensure they didn’t abuse their power.
For years, Lady Lani believed her best friend died.
So now that they are reunited, had Kent and Alina not been around, they would probably be hugging and crying tears of joy by now.
"Are you here for the Pill Master Competition?" Lady Lani asked.
"Yes. But first, I want to go see Big Sister Vari," Kent smiled, having already reached the brother-and-sister name basis with one of the strongest beings on the entire continent.
Lady Lani just sighed.
"She is also expecting you." Kent stood up.
"She is in the same room you met her in last time." He nodded, looking at Alina.
"I will be back soon, my Sunshine." Alina blushed, watching Kent go. When he was gone, the three ladies looked at each other.
"Big Sister Nara, how have you been?" Alina asked.
"I am well. It’s just that your sisters are just too shameless, so I had to catch some fresh air away from them," Nara replied, taking her veil off.
Lady Lani did the same, but one could tell she was stunned looking at Nara’s appearance.
Nara saw her expression and smile in her heart. But Lady Lani didn’t think too much about it and just smiled.
She then looked at Alina and asked,
"When did you two meet?"
Just now, Alina asked a question that suggested she and Nara had met. But as far as she was aware, Alina hadn’t gone anywhere in the past days.
If that was the case, then how in the hell were they talking like they knew each other? She wasn’t jealous of their relationship; she was just curious.
"What has that got to do with you?" Nara asked, looking at Lady Lani disdainfully. "Alina, don’t tell her anything. She is a worm that would work her way into your heart and destroy you from within."
Lady Lani just smirked.
"So what happened? Knowing you, dying is the last thing that will happen to you. So what happened?" She instead asked the question she had been meaning to ask.
"I was kidnapped. Could you believe that?" Though she said it sarcastically, her seriousness was evident. She truly felt the pain and was now projecting it.
"Though I should be laughing at you by now, I must first know who kidnapped you."
"Old Victor."
"Wait, Sect Master Victor was responsible for your death... or so we thought."
"Indeed. But he is dead now, so let’s talk about other things." Nara smiled. She may be fine with her new life, but she doesn’t want to hear more or even talk about the sect master.
Her will is strong, but some things are better left alone.
Of course, she would have to deal with it one of these days, but for now, she is fine and happy.
"How did you escape from the Forest Queen?" Before her presumed death, she had gotten a message from her saying she was trapped somewhere in the wild forest.
This made her take on a mission, and she planned to go save her. But he met the sect master on the way instead.
So, seeing her now meant she had survived and managed to escape. She most certainly wanted to know how.
"I had to come to an agreement with the bitch, so she let me go. I wanted to rub it in your face, but you died before I could get the chance."
"I guess that was my luck then." They laughed, but they continued to catch up.
Meanwhile, Kent appeared in VIP Room 1, where Protector Vari was waiting for him.
"You are here," Lady Vari said, sipping tea as she locked eyes with Kent. After sipping the tea, she set the cup down and adjusted her veil.
"Sit." Kent nodded and sat down.
Though he was shameless, she knew the lady before him was someone he had to give the much-needed respect.
"How are you?" Lady Vari said, looking curiously at Kent.
"I am doing well, Big Sister Vari." Kent smiled. "I can see you are also doing well."
"Oh, what shows I am doing well?" she asked with a furrowed brow.
"Someone as beautiful and capable as you wouldn’t be having a bad day, right?" He smiled.
"What if I am?"
"Then, as your little brother, I will advise Big Sister to get a man in her life."
For a moment, the two only stared at each other before bursting into small laughter.
"You can’t play this mind game with me, Kent. I am not Lani, who doesn’t even know you have already trapped her," she smirked.
"A wise man once said, ’They will never know until it’s too late.’" Kent smiled.
"Oh, so you think you can win this game?"
"Naturally, of course. Sometimes, you just have to listen to the heart and let it do the talking." He leaned in closer and smiled. "What is your heart telling you, Big Sister?"
"It’s telling me to hang you upside down and give you a good spanking," she giggled.
"I see. I guess your kink isn’t too bad. I will be sure to fulfill this wish of yours whenever I manage to sink my fangs into you," Kent laughed.
"You—" Lady Vari chose to stop while her sanity was still intact. The brat in front of her was rather good with his words.
Kent just smiled, knowing the lady in front of him wasn’t someone he could easily conquer. Strangely, he wasn’t really rushing to do anything.
It was like talking to her was enough for him. The lady was the strongest on the continent, yet here they were, joking and laughing like it was the most normal thing to do.
"Will you be coming to watch me do alchemy?" Kent asked.
"Why, are you scared somebody will attack you, so you want to use me as your shield?" Lady Vari asked, smiling.
"The gods wouldn’t forgive me if I used a beauty such as yourself as a meat shield. I just want you to come out and watch me concoct pills. It could be fun."
"I don’t dabble in mortal stuff, Kent. But don’t worry, I will keep an eye on you. But if your enemies come, know that you are on your own.
I will only step in if someone on my level comes after you."
Kent squinted his eyes, hearing that.

chapters.title: Chapter 427: Protector Vari’s Warning
paragraphs: Many things cannot be said whole just like that.
Some things are said through hints. When Lady Vari said she would only step in if someone on her level appeared, Kent knew there was a hidden message behind that.
Naturally, he understood what she was trying to say and nodded. He would certainly keep an eye out for such threats.
"Just be careful," she said in a calm tone. "You are like a treasure walking. Many people want their hands on your treasures, so do well to prioritize your safety above all."
"I will, Big Sister," Kent nodded.
"You do that. But if you can beat them, then be sure to give them a good beating. This is a cultivation world where the stronger stand at the peak."
"Big Sister, don’t worry, I have made arrangements before coming this time." Kent smiled. The strongest on the continent was telling him to beat people up; who was he to decline such a good offer?
"Then be well to visit me again after the competition. Also, if you don’t win, I will be sure to pull your ear and spank your bottom."
"I will be sure to fulfill your kink, my Big Sister. I will ensure you can’t sit on those perfect butts afterwards," Kent laughed, standing up.
"I will be leaving now, Big Sis," Kent said, and was about to take a step when Lady Vari spoke.
"Stop playing mind games with my disciple. She is my cherished disciple." She spoke in a calm tone, yet she sounded amused.
"A wise man once said, ’If you have happiness in abundance, then share it with the beauties.’" Kent’s laughter echoed in the room as he walked away.
"This hateful bastard," Lady Vari smiled and sipped her tea.
A few seconds after Kent left, Lady Vari’s shadow shuddered, and a shadowy bird flew out of it and landed on the table.
"Swimmy, I want you to follow him and ensure he is always out of harm’s way. Though he is capable, the number of people who want him dead is just too many.
He would need your help." The shadow bird nodded and flew away, turning into a shadow.
"Better be careful, Kent. Though you may not realize it yet, the key to starting and perhaps ending the battle that is just around the corner revolves around you."
You better keep yourself safe."
After finishing her tea, she vanished from the room, appearing thousands of miles away, where she entered a secure room and started cultivating.
When Kent arrived in the room, the three ladies were talking about random stuff, with Nara and Lady Lani still bickering about random things.
Seeing that they would need a few more minutes to reunite, he took Alina away and entered a different VIP room.
The moment they entered, Alina activated the noise-canceling formation, jumped into Kent’s arms, and started kissing.
Soon, his clothes came off, leaving her naked. Kent went down on her, and for 30 minutes, he made her feel good.
Alina was made to moan her heart out thanks to how excellent Kent was with his tongue game.
She also went down on him.

When that was done, they decided to play the real game. Kent, who missed that butt, made sure he grabbed onto it, and for 2 hours, they had their moment, melting into each other’s arms after they were done.
"I miss you, Kent," Alina said, smiling at Kent.
"I miss you too, but since I am here now, we can spend some time together," Kent replied to her, making the sweet Alina smile.
Her hand was stroking the still stiff dragon while Kent was kneading her soft ass.
"So when would you be going to see Big Sister Vexthra?" Alina asked with a small blush. She knew what she wanted, but the only thing blocking her was her big sister, who had called dibs on it first.
"I will leave right after the competition, so in a week’s time, and will spend 3 days there," Kent smiled, kissing her cheek.
"Don’t worry, I will make you feel it down there right when I get back. For now, I will be taking Lady Lani off your hands so you can go back and spend some time with your sisters.
I will also awaken your true name when I am back."
Alina nodded.
"But before you leave, can we do it again? I am sure Big Sister Lani wouldn’t mind you spending time with me; she knows I have needs."
"Oooh, bold Alina. If you were this bold back then, I wouldn’t have fulfilled your kink a long time ago." Alina blushed and climbed on Kent.
After spending another two hours, they went back to the ladies, who only stared at them with expressions that held a lot.
Naturally, the dragon just smiled and shamelessly spoke the wise words.
"A wise man once said, ’When the time is ripe, you will receive your own.’"
They gave him the classic eye roll.

After spending some time, Alina left, vanishing into the tower, shocking Lady Lani, who became curious. Of course, Kent didn’t mind taking her there, but for now, he must handle what he came there for.
"I will be leaving with you two."
"Why? I didn’t plan on babysitting you, unlike her, who doesn’t have anything going on in her life," Lady Lani said.
"You—"
"I can tell you two still have a lot to talk about, so you will spend the week together, meaning you will spend it with me.
Don’t worry, I will only require hugs from both sides in the evenings."
He laughed, but after a few more back and forths, he would be spending the night with the two for the duration of the competition.
"Then where do you plan on staying?" Lady Lani asked.
"Shadow Light Hotel. We have an entire suite to ourselves."
Lady Lani handled a few things before leaving with Kent. Though he was in Vasport City, it wasn’t a place he could go back and forth from, for the distance was not small.
Of course, she could move back and forth easily with her cultivation base, but that would defeat the purpose of spending a week with him and her back from the dead best friend slash Rival.
So she would be joining him.
Just like that, the dragon would be spending the week with two amazing fairies who would never stop bickering until he gave them a dose of the dragon juice.

chapters.title: Chapter 428: The Seven Pill Geniuses
paragraphs: After leaving the Green Leaf Auction House, Kent and the two ladies first had dinner in a lush restaurant before leaving for the Shadow Light Hotel, where they spent the night.
Of course, it was Nara and Lady Lani still catching up with Kent, spending the night to trying to gain a good grasp of the dangers he will be finding himself in.
Since he and Nara wouldn’t be entering the tower for the duration of the competition, he can only be prepared.
Naturally, the hotel is filled with people who are keeping an eye on him.
Most are even trying to use their senses to spy on him, but he made plans for that. With the tower, if he doesn’t want you spying on him, you won’t be able to do anything to him.
So after spending the night identifying close to eight people keeping an eye on him, he knew he had walked into yet another trap. As to whether he was really concerned about that, he wasn’t.
Even if these people were sovereign, he wasn’t about to despair. He wouldn’t be able to face them equally in combat, but their souls wouldn’t be able to face him in battle either.
Why?
Because his soul is at the Tier 10 stage, making him a Root Ascension stage soul cultivator. So, if they have souls stronger than his, then they wouldn’t be able to do much to him.
But even if they have trump cards he couldn’t easily defend against, his undead are there for that particular reason.
But until then, he wouldn’t cower in fear and run hiding like he would have before gaining the enlightenment.

"Are you sure you don’t want us to go with you? Some ants are poking around, you know," Nara said, staring at Kent, who had just informed them that he would be going to register but would be going alone.
Nara, being a night rider, picked up on some people snooping around the night before, so she knew Kent was being spied on.
"Don’t worry about them. They can continue following me. But if you are worried about my safety, know that I have everything in the bag," he laughed.
"Just be careful," Nara said, making Kent nod before walking away.
He knew if he wanted to get a good take on the dangers around him, he should let go of the two mysterious ladies with him for now. This would make those spying on him lower their guards.
It would be best to do what he wanted to.
So he left the hotel and headed toward the Pill Tower, which was sitting somewhere in Vastport City. It was currently filled with young alchemists, each there to show their talent.
Currently, these youngsters have arrived to register inside the Pill Tower where the competition will be taking place.
They were each sizing themselves up, with a few even engaging in arguments and some placing bets against each other.
Naturally, just like how there are top sects among the many sects, there are also geniuses among the pill masters gathered.
There are seven Pill Saints in the four kingdoms. They are the seven powerful figures of importance until one of them got greedy and nearly died chasing after Kent’s treasures.

A smile appeared on his face when he met Annabelle’s gaze.
"Kent... you are finally here," Annabelle said, gritting her teeth as she clenched her fist.
"Indeed... why, did you miss me?"

chapters.title: Chapter 429: Pill Saint’s Meet
paragraphs: Annabelle clenched her fist, looking at Kent as if she wanted to bite him.
"Don’t hurt yourself, Annabelle. I didn’t come to look for trouble today. This is an alchemy competition, so why don’t we finish that first?" He chuckled.
"Of course, if you want to die, you can also come against me now. I don’t mind sending you off."
Kent smiled, but that smile made the seven watching him shudder in their seats.
Annabelle, in particular, who had witnessed Kent face her master the last time they went looking for trouble with him, shuddered more than they did.
’Don’t do anything stupid, Annabelle.’ Suddenly, her master’s voice entered her mind, causing her to calm down.
"You better watch your back," she gritted her teeth, saying that.

"Oh, I will. But just like how the evil sect will soon fall, the same will happen to all those who will come after me. So bear that in mind," Kent smiled again before walking to a side and sitting down.
He took an apple from his tower storage and started munching on it, showing everyone that he wasn’t worried about anything.
The Pill Tower has three floors. The competition will be held on the first floor. Right now, only the disciples who will be participating are around.
This was why there are many empty spaces left for those who will be coming to watch after tomorrow. Today was for those who hadn’t registered yet.
The second floor is where the genius minds are, creating pill recipes and modifying already created ones to enhance their potency.
They stand for the true nature of the Pill Tower, the highest pill organization in the four kingdoms. It’s accessible to Pill Grandmasters and above.
However, the third floor is for the Pill Saints. Aside from them, nobody has ever stepped there. That is where they meet to determine how the pill market should be regulated.
It’s in the Athea Kingdom because commerce is highly regulated there, and the Athea Kingdom is known for that. They are the richest kingdom among the four.
However, there is something else going on there, and until now, nobody knew about the sins of the Pill Saints. They may be the most important figures in the world, but they are no Saints at heart.
Today, they met again, but instead of discussing making the pill market more accessible, they decided to scheme and plot.
"I know you all know there is a brat here who has things we all need. I managed to form a good relationship with him and even got close; however, the mysteries around him are just too many.
I am not confident I alone can handle him, so I called you all here to come together and see if we can do something about it."
Pill Saint Barton said, revealing his true colors.
"If my information is valid, that brat has a relationship with Sword King Shawn, so what makes you think I would want to go against him, knowing who I will be going against?"
Pill Saint Desmond asked, looking at the Saint everyone regarded as friendly, yet he is the most poisonous of them all.
"He is one person, and we wouldn’t be doing it ourselves, so what are you concerned about?" Pill Saint Barton said, sounding smug.

"Then who is stepping in for us? I doubt anybody would want to go against that Shawn bastard. Since he formed his Sword Realm and gained that enlightenment thanks to the fruit the brat gave him, he has become obsessed with him.
I doubt he will lower his guard knowing he is out now. The chances of him even guarding his hotel every night are high. That shameless bastard," Pill Saint Devin said.
"Devin, sometimes I don’t know if you and a pig are any different. How can a Pill Saint be as stupid as you?" Pill Saint Barton said, looking disdainfully at Pill Saint Devin.
"You—" The veins on Pill Saint Devin’s face began to pop.

"What? Haven’t you heard of the saying, ’The one closer to you is your biggest enemy’?" Barton smirked. "Do you think I will destroy my relationship with him when he hasn’t fallen, or if there’s no guarantee yet?
No.
On the surface, my disciple wouldn’t target him, and I will laugh and have tea with him. But his life will be mine for the taking when that is over.
There are so many ways to kill him and take his treasures," he smiled evilly.
"You are not thinking of using those evil bastards," Pill Saint Evilyn, the queen of Athea Kingdom, who is also one scheming lady, asked, making Barton smile.
"Indeed. I have been informed by a credible source that he will enter the Battlefield with the Silver Leaf Auction House expedition team.
"If we pour our resources together, getting them to kill him wouldn’t be a hassle."

"That would actually work, but what is the guarantee that we will get what we seek? For all we know, he has already hidden his treasures somewhere before coming out, thanks to those idiots from the evil sect."
Pill Saint Evilyn muttered, already looking a step ahead.

"Oh, but we don’t need his dead body. That is useless. We only need his soul, and thankfully for us, we have someone who can extract anything from any soul captured." Pill Saint Barton turned toward the wicked Poison Witch.
"What do you think, Poison Witch? Do you have what it takes to get what we want from him if we get his soul?. The last time I checked, you and he aren’t on speaking terms."
"That is as easy as it can be. But I will take 20% of the treasures, including at least one of the battle dolls."
There is no denying her claims. They wouldn’t be getting anything without her, so though her demands are just too much, they couldn’t deny that.
"Fine. But failure is not an option," Pill Saint Barton glared at her.
"Unlike you, I am reliable," the wicked Poison Witch smirked. However, her mind was doing a different thing.
’That brat knew I was poison, meaning he somehow figured out my true identity. Since that is the case, I can use this to my advantage.’ She looked at the six Pill Saints and smiled in her head.
’I hate schemers. So since that is the case, I will become a snitch to get what I want. Sorry, you six, but you will fail, and I will be the reason for that.’

chapters.title: Chapter 430: First Day of The Pill Master Competition
paragraphs: On the last floor of the Tower, a meeting centered around Kent was taking place without him even being aware of it.
If he had been aware, he would have probably been blown away by the kind of people attending this meeting and the topic of their discussion.
The queen of an entire kingdom was present, meaning she wasn’t as righteous as she appeared. Many saw her as a Saint, but she is one scheming demon.
But that was to be expected, for one could never tell what was truly in another’s heart.
A few hours after everyone arrived, a peak Transcendent appeared inside the large hall.
"Welcome, everyone, to this year’s Pill Master Competition," he began. "Before I start, who among you doesn’t have a pill badge?"
A few dozen raised their hands, Kent being one of them.
A pill badge is something all alchemists possess, which can be used to determine their rank. It was issued when one became a Pill Master.
At the Master stage, it was just a pill badge; however, the moment they became Pill Grandmasters, they would receive a new badge by taking the Pill Upgrade Exams.
The moment they received the new badge, which was actually a soul item, it was linked to their soul. As they advanced in their path, it continuously documented their achievements.
It would also change color, reflecting one’s progress in pill cultivation. Looking closely, Kent could tell that the badges hanging from either their chests or waist belts were all blue.
"Don’t worry if you don’t have one. Right after my announcement, you can register and obtain a blue badge, which will officially make you a Pill Master.
You all will start as one-star Pill Masters, but during the contest, if you surpass that level, your badge will be updated accordingly."
The badge, in addition to its color, had five stars.
One star indicated that one’s pill purity had reached 70%, two stars signified 80% purity, three meant 90%, four meant 95% purity, and five stars represented the pinnacle of pill mastery.
Kent smirked when he saw the three-star badges on the seven geniuses.
Naturally, nobody had ever obtained a five-star pill badge. Those can be found in the Elvin empire, where alchemy is well practiced.
But the badge here is the same in the Elvin empire. Since it was a universal item, it couldn’t be manipulated, so no one had ever reached that level.
However, the Saints had four-star badges, showcasing their mastery and deep understanding of the pill path.

"Now that we are done with the issue of badges and registration, know that the competition will take place in four forms: Spiritual Strength Testing, Memory Testing, Problem-Solving, and what we all love—the actual concoction trials.
This time, the spiritual testing will be measured at the peak of the Green Grade. This means that if your soul strength is below the Tier 4 stage, you will be disqualified."
A collective sigh escaped many lips. Those who knew they wouldn’t progress any further sighed, for they truly had no chance.
Their soul strength was simply too weak.
"Second, you will be presented with thousands of pill recipes, and you will be given a short time to memorize and record them afterward. The stronger your memory, the better.
The third test will involve fixing recipes selected from the second test, so the better your memory, the further you will go.
There will be mistakes in them, so all you have to do is memorise as many recipes as you can, and when the time comes, you can easily fix them.
As for the final challenge, the concocting competition will continue until the first-place winner is determined.
Now, before you all celebrate, know that only Tier 3 pills will be concocted this time, and the minimum acceptable purity is 60%."
Once again, heavy sighs filled the room, showing that many lacked confidence. Only a handful remained calm—those who were sure they could pass the trials.
"First, I know you are all ambitious. You want to impress the Saints. While that is admirable, understand that disgracing yourself will tarnish your reputation, as powerful figures will be present.
You wouldn’t want to leave them with a bad impression.

Rumor has it that the Master of the Silver Leaf Auction House will be attending. So, if you know you can’t handle the trials I mentioned, return and train harder. Your chance may come again in two years.
Second, each of you will receive one cauldron and ingredients for three potions. However, you are required to have your own cauldron as a backup."
Everyone nodded in acknowledgment.

"Very well. Those who have yet to register, proceed through that entrance and complete your registration. Tomorrow, be here before 10, as even a minute of lateness will result in automatic disqualification."
After the announcement, everyone dispersed, with Kent obtaining his badge before leaving. When he returned to the hotel, Lady Lani and Nara were not around, so he simply went to sleep.
Unlike those who cultivated every spare moment, he didn’t bother. His ladies told him not to focus on that, so he sleeps like a baby every night.
The next morning, he dressed up and went to pick up the ladies, who had returned the previous evening after touring the city and catching up on lost time from when Nara was—allegedly—dead.

After picking them up, they headed to the Pill Tower for the first day of the competition. When they arrived, only 45 participants, including Kent, were present. All seven geniuses had arrived before him.
The contestant doors were locked just under an hour later. Only 62 participants had arrived in time.
Kent was given a card with the number 46 on it, meaning he would be the 46th contestant to take the test.
Some people arrived a few minutes after the doors were locked but were not allowed in. Their lateness to the Pill Tower was a clear sign that they were neither serious nor ready for the contest.
"Good morning, everyone." The same elder who had made the previous announcement appeared and spoke.
"I welcome you all to this year’s Pill Master Competition. Having traveled from afar to witness these brilliant minds, it is an honor to have you here.
Before we begin, I would like to announce that the Seven Pill Saints will grant the winner of this year’s competition a wish. If it is within their power, they will fulfill it.
With that said, let the first competition begin."

The next morning, he dressed up and went to pick up the ladies, who had returned the previous evening after touring the city and catching up on lost time from when Nara was—allegedly—dead.
After picking them up, they headed to the Pill Tower for the first day of the competition.
When they arrived, only 45 participants, including Kent, were present.
All seven geniuses had arrived before him.
The contestant doors were locked just under an hour later.
Only 62 participants had arrived in time.
Kent was given a card with the number 46 on it, meaning he would be the 46th contestant to take the test.
Some people arrived a few minutes after the doors were locked but were not allowed in.
Their lateness to the Pill Tower was a clear sign that they were neither serious nor ready for the contest.
"Good morning, everyone." The same elder who had made the previous announcement appeared and spoke.
"I welcome you all to this year’s Pill Master Competition.
Having traveled from afar to witness these brilliant minds, it is an honor to have you here.
Before we begin, I would like to announce that the Seven Pill Saints will grant the winner of this year’s competition a wish.
If it is within their power, they will fulfill it.
With that said, let the first competition begin."

chapters.title: Chapter 431: Spiritual Strength Testing
paragraphs: The Pill Saints are already seated in a VIP room overlooking the competition that was about to begin.
Under normal circumstances, they only come for the Pill Concoction trials, but today, there is someone there they want to keep their eyes on.
Kent is a target they all want to exploit, so they will take advantage of any opportunity to get familiar with him.
Kent had already shown remarkable prowess and wealth, and as such, he is their target.
But that can wait; the competition has just started.
"The first trial will test your spiritual strength to ensure you meet the minimum requirement," the elder said.
"In the previous competition, you were only required to reach the green mark of the Soul Pillar, but this time around, you will be required to be at the peak of it, which will make you qualified.

This is to ensure that those who will remain aren’t overwhelmed by the rest of the trial. So, if you want to have a shot at qualifying, you are required to have soul strength as high as the Tier 4 stage."

The Soul Pillar has several markings that can be used to determine someone’s soul strength. The first mark is white, the second is blue, the third is yellow, the fourth is green, and the fifth is gold.
Since the green is at the fourth stage, this means it is required of one to have a soul strength of at least 4th Tier in soul cultivation.
Kent, who is at the 10th stage in soul cultivation, looked at the pillar and could only sigh.
⟪Would the master follow the plan and not show everything from the start?⟫ Dori asked. Kent had already told his three assistants his plan.
’Indeed,’ Kent replied.
Though he isn’t a Pill Grandmaster yet, his soul strength is at the 10th Tier, something not even the Pill Saints could boast of.
Most of them are only at the 7th Tier, so if his true soul strength were to be made public, many would bleed. This was why he wouldn’t do that.
But his main reason for not wanting to do that was because of the last requirement to become a Pill Grandmaster.
He must challenge a Pill Master to a duel. Now, this is a competition; it can’t be seen as a one-on-one competition.

However, he can make it a one-on-one competition while showing everyone he is capable. Since he won’t be shining just yet, he will make it so the one who will be shining would want but to challenge him.
His end game is that.
So instead of scaring everyone, he will play the game.

Of course, he knew the game was rigged, which was perfect for him. He will ensure that at the fourth stage of the trial, the competition will be fierce, and as such, one of the geniuses will challenge him.
’Ladies, just keep things moderated so I don’t break its pillar. It only has 8 markings, and I am at the 10th Tier, which will destroy it.’
⟪Then where would the master want to be?⟫
’Keep me below the second ranker.’
⟪Okay, master.⟫
Being the first from the get-go will be hard, so he will handle the geniuses by breaking their momentum while looking for his opponent.
"Without further ado, Michael Gyan, step forward." A young man in his early twenties stepped forward and walked toward the Soul Pillar.

"Just place your hands on it and channel your spiritual energy into it," the elder said, and the young man obeyed. He did as he was told, and as soon as he channeled his energy into the pillar, it lit up.
The white lit up, followed by the blue, yellow, and green. It moved and stopped just when the gold lit up.
"You’ve qualified to go to the next stage." The young man beamed with joy as he walked back smiling.
"Stacy Henny" was the next call. She also managed to stop at the gold rank, showing that she has the soul strength to handle the rest of the trial.
Kent stood on the side holding his tag, showing he was 46th to be called.
But he just stood there looking for his target, which he would use as the requirement to become a Pill Grandmaster.
Slowly, more people started passing until a dude named Lowell couldn’t get past the green light. He stopped in the middle, showing he couldn’t get to the next stage of the contest.
The dude just sighed and walked away, joining the audience.
After the tenth person was tested, Ragnar, one of the seven geniuses, turned and walked toward the pillar since he was the 11th.
"That is Ragnar; he is the disciple of Pill Saint Devin," one person in the audience said, and everyone started talking about him.
"I wonder if he also makes berserker pills like his master," one of them said.
"It’s only natural. Just like how the disciple of the Wicked Poison Witch specializes in poison pills, the rest of the disciples of the other saints wouldn’t be any different."
"If that is the case, then he is fortunate, I guess."
Ragnar stopped at the pillar and channeled his energy into it. The moment he did that, the first three lights lit up and quickly moved past the fourth and on to the fifth, which is a gold light.
It moved and stopped at the peak of the fifth stage, showing that his soul strength was at the peak of the fifth Tier.
The audience went wild, cheering him on.
Meanwhile, Kent just smirked and continued to watch.
A few calls later, the next genius went. Lucas, the disciple of Pill Saint Desmond. He also stopped at the peak, just like Ragnar did.𝓯𝓻𝒆𝙚𝒘𝓮𝙗𝓷𝒐𝓿𝙚𝒍.𝙘𝓸𝙢
Naturally, after the fifth genius also showed that they are at the peak of the fifth Tier, everyone could only cheer for them.
However, when the fifth genius left, a barefooted lady whose demeanor and appearance resembled someone more in tune with nature and highly spiritual approached the pillar next.
Kent raised an eyebrow when he sensed her use her soul strength to appraise him first before going.
When she touched the pillar, the first four lights lit up instantly, shocking everyone.
"That is Elaine, the top genius among the seven geniuses," someone said, smiling lustfully as they gazed at the emotionless Elaine channeling her energy into the pillar.

chapters.title: Chapter 432: Suspecting Him
paragraphs: "Wow, she is in the middle of the 6th Tier. What a monster." The pillar showed a dull brown color with the marker in the middle of it, showing that Elaine was a medium 6th Tier soul cultivator.
"She isn’t known as the genius among the seven for nothing."
"You are right. She is indeed talented. With this soul strength, she wouldn’t struggle much concocting even Tier 5 pills."
"That is true. Most Pill Grandmasters I know only have soul strength sitting at the peak of the 5th stage, and they even have decent purity under their belt.
This young lady has a great future ahead of her."
Her praises were being sung as she moved away from the pillar, looking toward Kent for a moment before she turned away.
A few more went after her until it reached Annabelle, the disciple of the Poison Wicked Witch. She moved toward the pillar with confident strides.

She is a prideful lady who, thanks to her master’s influence, was able to abuse her power over the years. She had caused harm to many and even went as far as suppressing many, thanks to her master’s position.
So while many would want to cheer her on, nobody wanted to get noticed by her.
Of course, there are a few influential figures who would want to get to know her and cheer her on, but she is just too scary.
Annabelle placed her hand on the pillar and channeled her energy. Like Elaine, the first four lit up and quickly moved to the sixth. However, hers stopped at the beginner stage of the sixth tier.
She could only sigh and let go of the pillar before moving away. After a while, Kent’s turn came.
"Isn’t that the kid who fought with the Evil Sect?" one person asked.
"Indeed. I learned he had cursed Evil Bat, making him run and hide—"
"Shush, do you want your entire family wiped out? This is the Evil Sect we are talking about." Before the person could finish his words, his friend stopped him.

"If he is still walking, then why can’t I be the same?" Naturally, the person was trying to be arrogant, considering that the words that the Evil Sect had closed its doors for a while now had reached everyone.
Kent made them bleed really hard, so watching him approach the pillar was a sign of respect.
"I never knew he was also an alchemist."
"One can never know everything. Such a handsome youngster was able to shake the hearts of many; being an alchemist shouldn’t be shocking at all."

Kent placed his hand on the pillar, and the first three lights lit up, followed by the fourth and fifth almost at the same time. Kent wanted to keep it casual, so the moment he entered the sixth, it stopped moving.
This placed him right below Annabelle, something he wanted to do. Of course, he could feel the eyes landing on him the moment he pulled back.𝑓𝑟𝑒𝘦𝓌𝑒𝑏𝑛𝑜𝘷𝑒𝘭.𝒸𝘰𝑚
These people are alchemists.
They dedicated their entire lives to alchemy, so for a swordsman to swoop in and measure higher than them is already an insult to them.
Kent could only smile in his head.

He even sensed the hardening gazes coming from the Pill Saints. This made him wonder why they were looking at him that way. But since they aren’t directing any intent toward him, he also didn’t pay much attention to them.
But that was their first mistake.
Those gazes he felt weren’t normal, so he knew deep within him, even though he didn’t want to admit it, that the Saints weren’t all friendly.
Then again, who was he kidding? He had just humiliated the disciples of the Pill Saints, so naturally, they would take offense.
Kent just ignored them and went to sit in one corner.
In the audience, Nara and Lady Lani smiled, watching the sour expressions on the faces of the geniuses who expected to compete among themselves.
They never expected Kent to be this awesome, breaking their momentum just like that.
But this also started calling into question what his true identity was.
Some started attributing him to the Perfect Alchemist. They think he is the Perfect Alchemist, which isn’t far-fetched.

Aside from Kent, who could be considered ordinary, the rest are renowned up-and-coming alchemists. And since they knew they weren’t good enough to be the Perfect Alchemist, they started to suspect Kent.
"This may be a long stretch, but I think he might be the Perfect Alchemist," a man in an expensive garment said.
Looking at him, one could already tell he was after the Perfect Alchemist, and that was why he came to that conclusion.
"Don’t be ridiculous, Veyne. How can a mere swordsman be the Perfect Alchemist? Sword King Shawn is a swordsman, but I learned his soul strength is already at the Tier 8 stage.
Just because he has stronger soul strength doesn’t mean he is the Perfect Alchemist. Don’t make a fool of yourself."
Another figure spoke, making the head of the Veyne noble family smirk.
"Kross, you’ve always underestimated people. Why, are you mad that he surpassed your son? You don’t want to believe he is that good in your eyes.
Maybe instead of looking down on people, you should train your wards to match up to their standards."
Kross Hinks, the head of the Kross noble family from the Athea Kingdom, gritted his teeth but didn’t say anything.
He knew what Veyne said was indeed true. Kent could actually be the Perfect Alchemist. But thinking about it made him want to claw his face off.
To him, his son Lucas, the disciple of Pill Saint Desmond, was the genius. He was a good father who believed in his son, but a deluded one who thought his son was better than everyone else.
After a few minutes, the last of the 62 who tested their soul strength was tested. Five couldn’t reach the required level, so they wouldn’t be joining the second trial.
"Congratulations to every last one of you. The next test will start shortly. Kindly make your way toward that room and sit based on the number on the tag given to you."

chapters.title: Chapter 433: Memorization Trial
paragraphs: The moment Kent entered the room, he located table 46 and sat behind it.
Soon everyone was seated.
"On your table is a Memory Crystal housing 1,200 pill recipes. You have 25 minutes to memorize as many recipes as you can.

After 25 minutes, you will be pulled out, and then the scroll on the table is there for you to write as many recipes as you can within 2 hours. Those with less than 300 correctly recorded recipes won’t qualify for the next round.
Know that if within the 25 minutes you are confident you can write a minimum of 300 recipes, then you can start off, after which you wouldn’t be able to enter the Memory Crystal again."
"Your time starts now."
When the time started, everyone hurriedly injected their spiritual energy into the Memory Crystal and started memorizing the recipes.
Kent waited for a few seconds, and after making sure everyone was busy memorizing, he also entered. When his spiritual energy entered the crystal, he was presented with 1,200 pill recipes.
He quickly went to comprehend them. However, 2 minutes later, he was done.
’That can’t be right,’ Kent said to the three ladies. Akira and Gaia turned to Dori, the mind weaver. This was her field.
⟪The master is not like everyone else. To most, their mind grows as they level up and grow in their cultivation. However, master, you were able to add points to it.
But on top of that, you are a genius. If you manage to comprehend seven skills in a single enlightenment, then this is but child’s play to you.⟫
’Hmm, I guess that makes sense. But to think 1,200 recipes can be learned just like that. It feels like cheating.’
⟪The master shouldn’t worry too much about that. You still have over 80 thousand points to add to your stats.
That alone should tell you who you are.⟫ Dori giggled, making Kent smile and pull his energy from the crystal.
He picked up the scroll and writing stick, which, thanks to Jest, he knew how to use.
He dipped it in the ink and started writing the recipes down.
He may have lied about his soul strength, but since this was about memory capacity, as a swordsman, he prided himself on his comprehension abilities, so he would show everyone what he was made of.
His writing abilities were also top-notch, so he wrote the recipes in the order they were given.
Fifteen minutes into the 25-minute period, Elaine also emerged from the memorization stage and started recording the recipes.
She was slightly shocked when she saw Kent already writing when she came out. But with her cold, emotionless expression, she started writing.
Annabelle was next, followed by Lucas, and then Seraphina, the disciple of the Queen of the Athea Kingdom. She was also a princess of the Athea Kingdom.
On the outside, everyone was watching with varied expressions.
They are in the room to cut off all noises and interferences from the audience.
Nobody expected Kent to start writing first. It was like he had declared he was better than the rest.
This only fueled the suspicion that he is the Perfect Alchemist.
After the 25 minutes were over, the contestants were ejected, as the elder had said. Then, for the next two hours, they each recorded the recipes they managed to memorize.
"Thank you all for taking the second test. Ten people couldn’t fulfill the requirement of 300 recipes, so they are disqualified from the next trial.
The results for those who wrote over 300 recipes will be available within the hour. Go out there and wait to see who wins the second test."
Kent left and went to his corner, where he started chatting with his ladies. Meanwhile, the seven geniuses started having a secret meeting.
"Do you think he can be the mysterious Perfect Alchemist?" Ragnar asked. "So far, he has shown remarkable prowess that suggests he indeed is the infamous Perfect Alchemist."
"Let’s not jump to a conclusion yet. But even if he is the Perfect Alchemist, after this competition, his life wouldn’t be the same again. So we can at least wait for now," Annabelle said.
The seven geniuses nodded.
They knew of all the schemes in the world of alchemy, so they understood Kent wouldn’t be having a good day if he was indeed this infamous Perfect Alchemist.
Meanwhile, the elder walked into the VIP room holding a scroll where the Saints were seated.
"My Saints, you have to see this." He unfurled the scroll, revealing its contents.
"Is that—" Pill Saint Desmond opened his mouth to speak, but the words couldn’t come out.
"Yes. The contestant, Kent Madson, managed to memorize and record all 1,200 recipes," the elder said, making the Pill Saints turn and look at each other.
"This can’t be real, right?" Pill Saint Enex asked.
"It’s right in front of us, Enex. What else is there to doubt? We should be asking whether to announce the results as they are or if we should do something about it," Pill Saint Evilyn said.
"We all have our suspicions about that kid, so announcing his true results will make those keeping a close eye on him suspicious.
"So why don’t we make him take the second spot or perhaps the third? This way, we can protect him now," Pill Saint Barton said like a righteous sage.
"During the concocting trials, if he has the capabilities, he can display them."
They all nodded. However, the look in their eyes said something else.
’With such a talent, I wonder what grade his Spirit Root is at the moment,’ Pill Saint Barton wondered, looking toward the purple-haired brat with hidden intentions.
"Give him the third spot," Pill Saint Riva said, making the elder nod. Under normal circumstances, he shouldn’t have brought this to them, but today was different.
Memorizing over a thousand recipes isn’t as simple as one might think. So it came as a shock, and now he knew why.
A few minutes later, the results were displayed.
Elaine was first.
Annabelle followed, and Kent became third with 450 recorded recipes. He could only smile happily while he continued to uncover things.

When his spiritual energy entered the crystal, he was presented with 1,200 pill recipes.
He quickly went to comprehend them.
However, 2 minutes later, he was done.
’That can’t be right,’ Kent said to the three ladies.
Akira and Gaia turned to Dori, the mind weaver.
This was her field.
⟪The master is not like everyone else.
To most, their mind grows as they level up and grow in their cultivation.
However, master, you were able to add points to it.
But on top of that, you are a genius.
If you manage to comprehend seven skills in a single enlightenment, then this is but child’s play to you.⟫
’Hmm, I guess that makes sense.
But to think 1,200 recipes can be learned just like that.
It feels like cheating.’
⟪The master shouldn’t worry too much about that.
You still have over 80 thousand points to add to your stats.
That alone should tell you who you are.⟫ Dori giggled, making Kent smile and pull his energy from the crystal.
He picked up the scroll and writing stick, which, thanks to Jest, he knew how to use.
He dipped it in the ink and started writing the recipes down.
He may have lied about his soul strength, but since this was about memory capacity, as a swordsman, he prided himself on his comprehension abilities, so he would show everyone what he was made of.
His writing abilities were also top-notch, so he wrote the recipes in the order they were given.
Fifteen minutes into the 25-minute period, Elaine also emerged from the memorization stage and started recording the recipes.
She was slightly shocked when she saw Kent already writing when she came out.
But with her cold, emotionless expression, she started writing.
Annabelle was next, followed by Lucas, and then Seraphina, the disciple of the Queen of the Athea Kingdom.
She was also a princess of the Athea Kingdom.
On the outside, everyone was watching with varied expressions.
They are in the room to cut off all noises and interferences from the audience.
Nobody expected Kent to start writing first.
It was like he had declared he was better than the rest.
This only fueled the suspicion that he is the Perfect Alchemist.
After the 25 minutes were over, the contestants were ejected, as the elder had said.
Then, for the next two hours, they each recorded the recipes they managed to memorize.
"Thank you all for taking the second test.
Ten people couldn’t fulfill the requirement of 300 recipes, so they are disqualified from the next trial.
The results for those who wrote over 300 recipes will be available within the hour.
Go out there and wait to see who wins the second test."
Kent left and went to his corner, where he started chatting with his ladies.
Meanwhile, the seven geniuses started having a secret meeting.
"Do you think he can be the mysterious Perfect Alchemist?" Ragnar asked.
"So far, he has shown remarkable prowess that suggests he indeed is the infamous Perfect Alchemist."
"Let’s not jump to a conclusion yet.
But even if he is the Perfect Alchemist, after this competition, his life wouldn’t be the same again.
So we can at least wait for now," Annabelle said.
The seven geniuses nodded.
They knew of all the schemes in the world of alchemy, so they understood Kent wouldn’t be having a good day if he was indeed this infamous Perfect Alchemist.
Meanwhile, the elder walked into the VIP room holding a scroll where the Saints were seated.
"My Saints, you have to see this." He unfurled the scroll, revealing its contents.
"Is that—" Pill Saint Desmond opened his mouth to speak, but the words couldn’t come out.
"Yes.
The contestant, Kent Madson, managed to memorize and record all 1,200 recipes," the elder said, making the Pill Saints turn and look at each other.
"This can’t be real, right?" Pill Saint Enex asked.
"It’s right in front of us, Enex.
What else is there to doubt?
We should be asking whether to announce the results as they are or if we should do something about it," Pill Saint Evilyn said.
"We all have our suspicions about that kid, so announcing his true results will make those keeping a close eye on him suspicious.
"So why don’t we make him take the second spot or perhaps the third?
This way, we can protect him now," Pill Saint Barton said like a righteous sage.
"During the concocting trials, if he has the capabilities, he can display them."
They all nodded.
However, the look in their eyes said something else.
’With such a talent, I wonder what grade his Spirit Root is at the moment,’ Pill Saint Barton wondered, looking toward the purple-haired brat with hidden intentions.
"Give him the third spot," Pill Saint Riva said, making the elder nod.
Under normal circumstances, he shouldn’t have brought this to them, but today was different.
Memorizing over a thousand recipes isn’t as simple as one might think.
So it came as a shock, and now he knew why.
A few minutes later, the results were displayed.
Elaine was first.
Annabelle followed, and Kent became third with 450 recorded recipes.
He could only smile happily while he continued to uncover things.

chapters.title: Chapter 434: The Third Trial
paragraphs: The domino effect.
Provided there are no empty spaces, the first domino will be the downfall of all.
Kent isn’t as stupid as the Saints were trying to make him seem.
He is very intelligent and could tell when something was amiss.
He saw from his past memories how smart Jest is. This gave him even more confidence to trust in his own intelligence.
So when the results came out and his name was third, he knew what they were up to.
Of course, they could lie and say they did that to keep him safe, but he never asked for that, and he knew that regardless of what they did, his identity would come out soon.
So then why would they manipulate his results?
He just smiled at that and let it slide as the third trial of the day was upon them.

"The third trial is simple. You will be presented with 700 incorrect pill recipes. You are required to fix them. Know that these 700 recipes will be coming from the second trial that just ended," the Elder said, making the 40 remaining nod.
Right after the second trial, ten people were disqualified for not having 300-plus recipes written on their scroll. These ten were just waved goodbye, leaving 47.
However, after checking the correctness of the remaining 47 scrolls, seven couldn’t produce 300-plus valid recipes, so they were also let go.
Now, only 40 remain, and they are now led to the same room with new tags.
Kent is now seated behind table 3, right behind Annabelle, who keeps turning and looking at him out of the corner of her eye.
Kent just smirks every time.
He can tell she has been pampered so much that she is simply spoiled. Fixing her will require a good old-fashioned reality check.
But since he wasn’t there for any trouble, he will focus on alchemy first.
After all, the endgame is to kill the God of Alchemy, and the best way to do that is to use alchemy to flush him out.
There are no Pill Supremes and Celestials in the universe. The last one vanished billions of years ago, so the highest alchemist in the universe is the Pill God.
That is Kent’s target, per his promise to Vexthra when she gave him a new body and a second chance at life. So, he will take alchemy seriously, just as he is taking the sword.
Two scrolls are before him and a writing stick. One of the scrolls contains the incorrect recipes, and the second is for recording the correct ones.
"This trial is only two hours," the Elder said.

"Your time starts now," he gave the order, making Kent and the others immediately get to work. Kent opened the scrolls, and truth be told, the recipes were indeed wrong when he set his sights on them.
However, as if his very existence were against the incorrect recipes, his eagerness to correct them filled him, making even Kent wonder where that feeling was coming from.
It was like he hated what he was seeing.
He picked up the writing stick, dipped its tip into the dark ink, and started recording the correct recipes. He didn’t know why he felt that way, but didn’t like seeing the wrong recipes.
He made sure he recorded everything correctly and in the order he was given.
Forty-five minutes later, he was done and placed the stick down.
In the VIP room, the Saints who were watching everyone turned and looked at each other. They knew one of two things would happen if they didn’t become careful.

Kent spent less than an hour finishing the recipes, and clearly, everyone saw that. So when the results came out, they would expect to see his name in the first spot, for they knew he had written all the correct recipes on the scroll.
So if they instead chose to bump down his ranking, people would notice. This meant they could only ensure he wasn’t suppressed like before.
But they were also not willing to make him first.
Initially, Kent knew this would happen and was happy about it. He didn’t care about the ranking. When the real alchemy began, he gradually showed everyone his mastery.
His focus now was the killing intent that came from one of the audience just then. He felt it, and then he felt it move away.
This brought a smile to his lips. So while the person was hovering around, he knew they would soon make their presence known.
He already had measures in place for that too.
After a while, the two hours passed, and the trial ended. They moved out and waited for another hour until the results came out.

As he expected, Elaine was first, Annabelle was second, and Kent was still third. Many started scratching their throats, but they didn’t say anything since doing so would mean going against the Pill Saints.
They wouldn’t do that unless it was obvious and they couldn’t take it anymore.
Ten more couldn’t progress to the next stage of the competition, so they were waved goodbye.

"That will be all for the first day. Tomorrow, there will be two trials, after which only 14 will be left. Prepare well, for the real pill concoction, or as most call it, the real alchemy, will begin tomorrow."
The contestants nodded, and everyone was dismissed.
Kent left right when they closed and met up with Lady Lani and Nara, who could only shake their heads throughout the three trials.

"You sure know how to cause trouble, Kent. I knew you wouldn’t be able to hide it anymore," Lady Lani, who already knew he was the Perfect Alchemist, said as they rode back to the hotel in their flying golden carriage.
"They seem to think otherwise. But they shouldn’t worry. I will show them I am not that weak tomorrow," Kent smiled.
"So, are you showing everyone your true identity tomorrow?" she asked again.
"No. But I will be picking my challenger tomorrow." Since he needs a pill master as an opponent for his last requirement to become a Pill Grandmaster, he can only create one.𝙛𝒓𝓮𝙚𝔀𝒆𝒃𝓷𝒐𝓿𝙚𝓵.𝙘𝒐𝒎
Naturally, his target is Elaine, the disciple of Pill Saint Enex.
After flying for a few minutes, Kent and the two beautiful ladies looked to their right. Kent smiled.
"They never learn."

chapters.title: Chapter 435: Gentlemen, Shall We?
paragraphs: Right after Kent finished writing down the correct recipes, he sensed a faint killing intent from a certain direction in the audience.
He smiled but didn’t make it obvious so the person wouldn’t know he had sensed them. Kent knew the person was just trying to appraise him.
But the only mistake they made was revealing they weren’t friendly. And since his soul strength had reached the Tier 10 stage, anyone below that could easily be figured out.
Kent knew the one scanning him wasn’t a friend, so he became hostile as well.

Before coming to the competition, he had prepared, and one of those preparations was using his Skill Upgrade Points to enhance the [Soul Shock] skill he had purchased when he was at the Green Gate Bazaar with his ladies.
It was a mere Heaven-grade skill, but after upgrading it to the Mystical grade, he unlocked new, powerful abilities from that one skill alone.
One such ability is called [Soul Brand].
It allows him to brand someone’s soul as long as they are within his soul-sensing range. With Kent’s soul at Tier 10, his sensing range could extend several miles.
This allowed him to brand this person, and from that, he began keeping track of them.

When he and the other contestants came out, he felt the person move out of his sensing range. Naturally, he knew they had gone to inform their team or master—or whoever—that he would soon be leaving the Pill Tower.
Kent was ready for them.
So, when the person appeared again on their way, he sensed him.
Nara, who was gaining her connection to the night simply because night was drawing near, also sensed the person. Lady Lani, a Sovereign, could sense hundreds of miles away.
"How are we going to handle that?" Nara asked.
"Like always, we first slow down the carriage, and I will go handle it," Kent smiled.
"You are not going alone," Nara said, already ready for battle.
"Fine, you can come and watch, but only watching, no fighting." That was good enough for her.
"How confident are you in hiding your presence?" Kent asked, and in response, Nara extended her hand and made something dark appear in it.
It was a bracelet. Looking closely, Kent could tell it’s a soul item.
The moment she placed it on her wrist, her presence vanished, leaving no trace.
"That is the Night Bracelet. The moment I wear it, it merges me with the night. Not even a god can sense me."
"But I presume it can’t be used for an extended amount of time, judging by how much it was absorbing from you," Kent smiled, and Lady Lani could only watch and pick up a few things.
She had pestered her friend to tell her what she was now and how come she had become more beautiful than her, but Nara only teased her the entire time.
Now, she was learning something about her, at least.
"It’s true the energy consumption is high. But night is only thirty minutes away. When it falls upon me, I will become invincible.
Meaning, in the next thirty minutes, I will use my own energy, but after that, the night will take care of the rest," Nara smiled, looking at her friend.
"What a cheat of an existence," Kent laughed and looked at Lady Lani.
"You are a Sovereign with the Darkness Affinity, so I am not worried." Lady Lani nodded, smiling behind her veil.
"Then I will be sure to give you a good show," Kent smiled and vanished from the carriage.
The next second, he appeared atop a tall building. He focused his attention on one spot where a figure could be seen sneaking around, following the golden carriage.
He shook his head and vanished again.
After moving for a while, the figure stopped and retrieved a talisman. "They are nearing the location. I will break the talisman so you all come when they get to the location."
He put away the talisman and was about to move when someone held him by the shoulder and whispered in his ear,
"Why wait when we can do it now?" The assassin froze, but before he could even look at the person who spoke, a sword pierced his heart, killing him.
Kent let go of his shoulder and let him fall. The moment he did, he used the soul absorber to extract his memories and soul, giving him a clear idea of where to go next.
The first time he used this ability was when he was going to rescue Li Hua. It was also when he became a Soul Cultivator and gained the [Soul Absorb] skill.
It allows him to absorb the soul of his kills and temporarily take in their memories too.
This was a way to know where or who he was dealing with.
A rather convenient skill.
So he used it on the assassin he had just killed and extracted his memories. He quickly went through them and soon located the rest of the assassins waiting to be summoned.
He didn’t even consider wasting his own time since he knew these were just the first of the true dangers, and he wouldn’t want to give them a chance to retreat.
If their man didn’t report back within the next few minutes, they would know something wasn’t right and flee.
Kent looked at the dead assassin for a few seconds and vanished, going after the rest.
At one corner of Vastport City, a slightly worn-out house sat quietly, now occupied by fifteen assassins. Ten were Root Transcendents, and five were at the Ascension stage.
They were ready for a mission and were only awaiting the green light.
They knew it would come soon, so they were all on high alert. Suddenly, somebody kicked in the door and walked in.
They all stood up, and those who would take out their daggers, crossbows, short swords, and all kinds of assassin-type weapons did.
Kent walked calmly and entered the compound of this small house. He looked around and counted fifteen assassins.
Naturally, they recognized him too, so they became alert. The Kent they were sent to kill was now in front of them.
"A wise man once said, when he kicks in your door and walks calmly in, know he is after your life." Kent smiled and looked around again.
"Gentlemen, shall we?"
