But that could wait for now.
Kent had won this round, and they could only frown in peace.
"The second round will be slightly difficult," the elder began.
"The pill for the second round is the Bone Tempering Pill."
Gasps rippled across the space when they heard the name of the pill the contestants will be making.
The first round was the Bone Hardening Pill, which is the easiest to make.
But the Bone Tempering Pill isn’t one that can easily be made.
The reason being, unlike the Bone Hardening Pill, which is a 7-ingredient pill, the Bone Tempering Pill is a 14-ingredient pill and one of the top Tier 3 pills every pill master will struggle with.
This is where one is required to have high spiritual energy; otherwise, the pill wouldn’t finish concocting, and you will run out.
The elder smiled.
"Of course, while the pill is hard to make, you have three portions of the ingredients, so this means third time’s the charm.
Again, before you think you will run trials before focusing on the real thing, know that you only have three hours.
This means you will only have an hour of trial session since the required time for this pill is mostly within the second hour.
Also, the passing purity level is now 85%.
Anything below that won’t be accepted.
Good luck, and may the best alchemist win."
The moment the elder ended his speech, everyone rushed to start concocting, except Kent.
He just sat there.
There wasn’t even a cauldron on his table, simply because he destroyed the first one in the first round.
However, nobody said anything.
He just sat there and continued to stare at Elaine, who was among the 21 who started working on their pill.
She divided the ingredients and lit her pill flame within 10 minutes, starting to heat the cauldron.
She had a yellow pill flame, which, if its source were traced, would be a flame from a rare spirit beast called the Winding Flame Bat.
It’s a good flame that requires less spiritual qi to harness.
Since the beast it came from has both the wind and flame elements, the flame has some traces of the wind element in it, making harnessing it much easier.
But that doesn’t mean she can casually use it without much attention to her control.
Naturally, Kent was impressed with her handling of the flame until she started extracting the second ingredient; that was when he noticed she wasn’t really that good.
It was just that she made sure her pill flame didn’t suddenly fluctuate, which in that case would destroy her process.
But that is admirable at best.

’She is good, but she can be better with the right techniques,’ Kent said to himself, considering he had such good techniques in the hundreds and had mastered them since they all just came naturally to him.
It was strange, but he wasn’t complaining.
An hour was almost nearing, yet Kent was still there watching his opponent.
Naturally, Kent was doing something that would shock everyone but could also go against him if his ego got the best of him.
When the first hour of the three-hour duration was reached, many started talking about the stunt he was pulling.
"I am confused right now.
Is he perhaps forfeiting the duel, knowing he will lose?" someone asked.
"Maybe he doesn’t know the recipe.
I noticed there are three wrong ingredients in the ones provided.
Maybe he doesn’t know which ones to use."
"I think so, too.
Perhaps he doesn’t know what to do with them, so he just wants to copy from Elaine."
Human nature is flawed in this aspect.
Just an hour ago, they were applauding him, and now he was being branded a thief.
That was just like seeing him as a saint and a devil in the same body.
Time went by, and before long, two hours had passed, leaving only an hour more.
Elaine was done extracting the pill and was even burning impurities and forming the pill.
However, not everyone managed to get their luck.
Over ten contestants burned two portions of their ingredients, automatically disqualifying themselves.
Even some of the seven geniuses were struggling.
However, they didn’t wash out, considering they managed to form the pill.
However, they were not confident in their abilities to surpass 85% purity or even reach it.
"Puff."
A dark smoke came from Elaine’s cauldron, accompanied by the smell of a pill.
"She succeeded in making the pill," one person from the audience said, prompting everyone to clap for her.𝕗𝚛𝚎𝚎𝐰𝗲𝗯𝗻𝚘𝚟𝚎𝗹.𝕔𝐨𝕞
Even Kent wasn’t an exception.
He was clapping, but he had his own intentions in mind.
She retrieved the pill and placed it in her pill bottle.
"92% pure, not bad at all," Kent said, making Elaine turn and look at him.
"Have you given up, considering you have less than 50 minutes?" she asked disappointedly.
It seemed she didn’t like seeing her opponent not doing anything.
It felt like a plan she had in mind was getting destroyed, and she didn’t want that.
"You haven’t given up, have you?" She asked again.
Kent smiled.
"Actually, I was waiting for you to finish so that I could borrow your cauldron."

chapters.title: Chapter 447: The Perfect Alchemist
paragraphs: There are two people in the world.
There are the others, and then there is Kent.
The brat is just shameless and infuriating.
Hating and loving him is the hardest thing a person can do. In fact, Kent is just too annoying.
Elaine, who was receiving his request, just didn’t know what to say. She sat there for ten straight minutes, not knowing what to say.
This brought the remaining time to 40 minutes.
"Well, lady, are you going to give it to me, or should I ask my dear friend Annabelle?" Kent asked. Annabelle was also done and was looking at the two.
Hearing Kent would ask for her cauldron, she quickly put it in her space ring. This caused many, including Kent, to laugh.
"Come take it," Elaine sighed.
Kent smiled and went for the cauldron. He tapped into his space ring, retrieved a gourd of water, and quickly cleaned the inside of the cauldron—even wasting five minutes just cleaning it.
"Then I will start. Watch closely, for today might be your first and last time watching the Perfect Alchemist at work."
Kent’s words drew everyone’s attention as he lit the Blue Void Flame. The moment the flame came out, its intensity increased, enveloping the entire cauldron.
"What in the world... That is Elaine’s technique!" The fanatics of Elaine recognized her technique immediately.
Elaine also became shocked watching Kent use her flame control art.
They called it the Hugging Cauldron Flame Control Art.
It basically envelops the entire cauldron like it was hugging it. It’s her signature technique; not even her master can use it since it came with her pill flame.
"I hope you don’t mind me borrowing your pill flame control technique too," Kent smiled, making Elaine’s expression one of shock.
"Don’t worry, I will give you the complete technique after you are done being my servant. But for now, watch closely."
Kent waved his hand, and the lid slid off the cauldron.
He waved his hand again, and the fourteen ingredients flew up and hovered above the opened end of the cauldron.
This even made everyone widen their eyes, thinking he was about to do complete extractions. This means he will be sending the entire ingredient set into the cauldron.
However, Kent didn’t do that, considering he hadn’t mastered that technique yet.
He would have to become a Pill Grandmaster first and, perhaps, a Pill Saint before he would get that far and be knowledgeable.
But today, he was shocking everyone by using Elaine’s pill flame technique and her cauldron to compete against her.
Naturally, her technique was something Kent received when he first opened the Primordial Pill Records back when he just arrived in the mortal realm.
It’s a good pill-flame control art, but it isn’t the best. Basically, the Hugging Cauldron Flame Control Art is just a small part of the real technique called the Alchemy Hugging Flame Art.
Kent knew all that because the first form, which was the Hugging Cauldron Flame Control Art, was given to him when he was just a novice.
Now, he has the second and third forms, which are the Alchemist Palm Welcoming Art and the Purification Ritual Art.
"Your technique is required to be used with the cauldron opened," Kent said. "Now watch."
He moved his hand as if forming a seal, and from the inside of the cauldron, two open palms rose, taking hold of an ingredient and pulled it into the cauldron.
"What was that?" someone asked, but before an answer could come, another set of palms rose and took the second ingredient into the cauldron.𝒇𝓻𝓮𝓮𝙬𝙚𝒃𝒏𝓸𝙫𝒆𝙡.𝓬𝓸𝒎
"Don’t tell me he managed to extract the essence in under a minute."
All of these questions were being answered whenever the set of palms rose and took in any ingredient.
Within five minutes, all fourteen ingredients were taken in, and the flame rose again.
Kent burned the impurities while condensing the pill at the same time. It was one of those rare sights any alchemist would be privileged to see.
Within twenty minutes, the pill was formed. But the moment it was formed, everyone sighed. They expected the light that was rumored to come out of the cauldron when a perfect pill was formed.
It didn’t appear here, making them wonder just where his initial bragging came from. Some started cursing at him, but a few were paying attention.
Naturally, those cursing realized he wasn’t done, so they stopped.
But watching Kent smiling, they wanted to know if he was just wasting their time.
"This is the final part," Kent said, changing the control of the flame. At once, the flame changed as five opened palms rose from the cauldron, with the pill hovering at the center.
He changed it again, and that was when the opened palms closed slightly and soon covered the pill.
Everyone gasped, watching this display with shocked expressions.
It just didn’t make sense.
At most, he should be doing that inside the cauldron, but now the pill was outside of it, covered by five opened palms.
It wasn’t something they’d seen before.
Kent held his smile for another five minutes before a brilliant light came from the open fingers of the five palms, turning everyone’s shocked expressions to expectations.
This, of course, was because they wanted to see their first perfect pill.
It didn’t take long since the moment the light receded, the flaming hands dispersed, leaving only the pill to remain hanging in the air.
Gasp.
Everyone gasped, watching the pill that didn’t require even an appraisal to know it was a perfect pill. looked beautiful and perfectly clean.
"I never thought I would ever see a perfect pill in this life or the next," someone from the audience said, making everyone nod.
Someone also wondered, "So he really is the perfect alchemist. Why does it look unbelievable despite him being right in front of us?"
"That’s because while we are only alchemists, he is a swordsman and an alchemist. This means he is walking two paths, yet he is better than us. Does that clear your confusion for you?"
The alchemists there sighed, watching as Kent placed the pill in an expensive pill bottle. He then looked at Elaine and smiled.
"Don’t worry, you can always call me Kent. No need to call me master, unless you want to."

Everyone sighed, knowing there was no need to argue this. Kent won fair and square. However, while there were those who understood reason, there were also those who just didn’t want to accept reality.
"Are you sure you want to take the disciple of a Pill Saint as your servant?" a voice came from the VIP room.

chapters.title: Chapter 448: Never Bet Against Me
paragraphs: In this world, when a Pill Saint came asking to become his disciple, saying no was the last thing anyone wanted.
This offer was made to Elaine nineteen years ago, and she couldn’t say no.
She wanted to strive and become an alchemist with the ultimate goal of helping her parents extend their craft to other stages. She wanted them to become versatile in healing those seeking their help.
She was very happy with that outcome.
So she left home, leaving her parents and traveling thousands of miles just to realize her dream.
This was what she wanted; however, when she started, her expectations were different from her desires.
Elaine was a quiet lady.
She is respectful, and even if you do her wrong, she will endure.
However, as she learned more about her master, she began to question whether she really wanted to train under him.
For years, she wondered about that until five years ago, when she made her decision known to her master. She told him she wasn’t ready to experiment with the lives of others, so she was leaving.
She rejected the offer to use her life magic to harm others.
Life magic is rare; it’s one that is meant to heal, not hurt. But if your master is the ambitious type who cares nothing for morales, you will be forced to take matters into your own hands.
She said what she had bottled up for years.
But to her horror, she found out that long before she made up her mind, her master had already taken drastic action. This was why she couldn’t leave.

Leaving meant forfeiting the lives of her parents. The same parents who had taught her everything about life and magic were now the roadblock she just couldn’t cross, regardless of how much she wanted to be free.
So she was forced to start using her life magic to hurt her fellow humans in the hope of making her master happy and releasing the grim scythe hanging above her parents.
But even after years of doing such demented acts, she was never able to achieve that.
So the quiet Elaine.

The pure and innocent Elaine is forced to continue living a bitter life. She didn’t want to be the reason her parents died, despite knowing they would gladly lay down their lives if it meant her happiness.
Elaine was trapped with no chance of escape.
However, a few months ago, news spread that a certain brat accepted a challenge from one Saintess known to have a rather large mouth.
The battle ended in this brat’s favor, and to everyone’s shock, he smiled in the face of all threats coming from the powerful background this Saintess possessed.
An entire sect couldn’t make him release this Saintess.
This made Elaine become interested in knowing about him.
So she started following his stories. She could tell if she managed to make contact, this daring brat would rescue her.
She was ready to pay any price.
Everything changed when news spread of how this brat killed hundreds and forced a sovereign from the ruthless evil sect into hiding.
It was the most unbelievable thing, yet it was the truth.
It didn’t take long for her to hear that this brat would be coming to the Pill Master competition. At that moment, Elaine formed the best plan to free herself.
She knew Kent was her way out.
So she started to scheme.
They say if the innocent endure the torture of the wicked for long, they will become the most ruthless schemers.
This made Elaine take on a new form, and for months, she made sure all forms of suspicion her master had of her were wiped away. She became the best disciple, making her master confide more in her.
So when she came up with the idea of challenging Kent, knowing her master was interested in him too, He was thrilled and even helped her form the perfect plan.
If only he knew this was all her plan: hiding behind Kent and, in doing so, making Kent her shield, which would also shield her parents.
It was a huge gamble, but she took it.
If Kent was able to take something from an entire sect, then her master was no threat. Still, he knew since it would be a bet, she wouldn’t be able to go back on her words.
Meaning her parents will be safe if she loses the bet.
However, when she met Kent, her plan changed, and it wasn’t hers anymore but the purple-haired brat’s, who knew everything about her despite her not knowing anything about him.
Kent made contact with her even before she challenged her thanks to the universe. This shocked Elaine to the core.
And from the way he acted, it was like her fairy godmother had sent him to save her.
Back to Kent...

When Kent first saw the barefoot lady, a sound rang in his mind, indicating he had received a quest. He quickly checked it, and to his shock, the quest was for him to save the young lady and her parents.
Kent didn’t ask much; he just followed the quest, knowing this was what the universe wanted.
This made him set the ruthless Sylara and the more human Saden on the mission. One was meant to kill, and the other was meant to take the two humans back to the tower.
The universe even gave him the location of Elaine’s village, where her small home was, and who was keeping an eye on her parents.
Naturally, Kent could sense the universe was angry. This also strangely made him angry.
He knew the kingdom must lose one Pill Saint, for he had already marked Pill Saint Enex. He will soon die regardless of where he hid.
But before that, he must ensure everyone knew what a demented person he was.
So he gave everyone a good show, telling them he is indeed the Perfect Alchemist. But the moment that happens, it means Elaine is now his servant.
But this means the bait that Pill Saint Enex set wasn’t able to catch any fish.
"Are you sure you want to take the disciple of a Pill Saint as your servant?" Pill Saint Enex spoke, making everyone quiet down.

"It’s a bet, and she lost. So, of course, she will be becoming my servant for the next ten years. I am sure she has integrity and wouldn’t go against the stakes even if Sword King Shawn wasn’t the one enforcing it." Kent smiled.
"Never Bet Against Me" His smile turned into laughter.
"Disciple Elaine, are you sure you want to become his servant?" His question was simple, but to Elaine, the meaning was just too triggering.
She knew the question was about her parents, and as someone who loves them, she hesitated. She turned and looked at Kent.
Kent saw this and smiled.
"If you are worried about your parents, know that they are safe." Kent chuckled and looked toward the VIP room.
"Your thugs keeping her parents hostage are dead. I made sure of that so Elaine is free."
Gasp...
Everyone gasped, including Elaine.
Even the Pill Saints felt their spines tighten.

chapters.title: Chapter 449: A Grim Promise
paragraphs: There is one thing to assure Elaine her parents are safe and another to turn to her master and accuse him of taking her parents hostage.
These two things are not easy to say boldly.
On one side, Elaine was just exposed as someone being held against her wishes.
Then, her master was exposed as the one doing the holding. He was the one who was making sure the lady didn’t have any say in how her life progressed.
These two discoveries were all made by a mere brat who was smiling like he hadn’t just accused a Pill Saint of doing evil deeds to his disciple.
"Pill Master Elaine, is it true your parents are being held hostage?" someone asked from the audience.
Elaine turned and looked at the VIP box where her master was and then back at Kent.
"You can answer. Your parents are no longer in harm’s way, so speaking the truth wouldn’t harm them," Kent said.
The moment those words brought Elaine’s confidence, Kent waved his hand.
Inside the VIP room, Pill Saint Enex’s face turned pale. It wasn’t because he had seen a ghost or held at gun point.
No.

He had just tried to soul attack Elaine, but it was blocked, and he could tell he was struck in return; however, he couldn’t tell why he hadn’t died, considering the soul strength that blocked him could easily kill him.
"You do know trying to kill your own disciple is a crime?" Kent asked, making everyone even more confused.
First, it was holding her parents hostage; now, it was him trying to kill his own disciple. It wasn’t making sense.
"Hey, brat, just because you’ve proven you’re the Perfect Alchemist doesn’t mean you can just start making accusations. Respect your seniors," Pill Saint Desmond said, appearing in thin air.
The other Pill Saints appeared, bringing with them their suffocating presence.
Looking up, one has to give it to them; they are worthy of admiration. Too bad they are all rotten to the core, every last one of them.
"You managed to win the duel, so where are all these accusations coming from?" Pill Saint Evilyn asked.
"But I wasn’t making accusations. This young lady has been under the control of her master for years, and while I know you all knew that, why ask this question then?
Or are you trying to say you knew nothing about this?"
Kent turned and looked at Elaine. "You don’t have to say anything if you don’t want to.

Your master was trash at heart, and from what I knew, trash makes friends with trash, so just go meet your parents." Kent waved his hand, and the young lady appeared in a lush garden sitting atop a beautiful mountain.
It was sunset inside the tower, so she was right on time to see her parents having tea. They seemed to have been there for a while now.
"Mom!"
"Dad!"
She called out, causing her parents to turn and smile at her.
"Kiddo," her mom called out, making Elaine break into tears as she ran and jumped into her arms. She may have forgotten she is now a grown-up to be acting like a spoiled little girl.
Thankfully, her mother is a Grandmaster, so she was able to handle her weight.
Meanwhile, on the outside, Kent was looking at the shocked faces of the Pill Saints and everyone watching.
"She is gone, and I doubt she will return after ten years," Kent smirked as he looked at the Pill Saint, whom he had initially thought was different.
He waved his hand, and ten vials of poison appeared.
"These are the ten vials of poison I promised you at the auction. Have them, and this concludes all interactions between us.
I initially thought you were different, but it seems you are the rottenest of the bunch. I wouldn’t come after you since you haven’t come after me, but I will make you this promise.
If you dare come after me, you will die. That is a promise, and it extends to you all. I don’t care how important you are to these four kingdoms. My threat is absolute and cannot be escaped.
You are Pill Saints, capable of concocting pills that can improve the lives of the masses. You are beings that can take and nurture young talents.
However, instead of doing that, you use them for your own good. As an alchemist, I am disgusted by such behavior, and you should also be disappointed and disgusted with yourselves.
’Take no life, use no life for a pill, and never use life as your main ingredient.’ That was what you should practice, yet you used your knowledge to hurt and destroy."
The more Kent spoke, the thicker the tension in the air became.
"I wouldn’t tell you what to do, but know what is good for you and stay out of my business. Like I said, you wouldn’t know how you died."
Kent next turned toward the wicked Poison Witch.
"I promised I would deactivate the seal on your disciple after the competition. Since this is the end for me, I will do that now."
Kent waved his hand, and the seal appeared on her forehead, causing Annabelle to sigh in relief. After that, Kent turned and faced the audience.
"I will soon start selling pills from Tier 3 upwards at the Silver Leaf Auction House. Announcements will be made when they are on sale.
Until then, I will be taking my leave." Kent didn’t even turn to look at the Pill Saints. He just flew away, showing his disgust.
Naturally, his anger wasn’t really coming from him.
It was like a part of him, the part that is in love with alchemy, was disgusted by the alchemists who were supposed to inspire.
They were supposed to be pillars of support and follow the righteous path of pill making. However, all he saw was disgust, which made him call them out.
Kent made them aware that they do not think and act supremely because they are Pill Saints. He made them aware that integrity is the most valuable aspect in the path of pill making.
It will depend on them whether they listen. But his warning stood; those who come after him will die, and this part of him that made that vow wasn’t jest or the Dragon Lord or even Kent himself.
No, it was a different part of him.
A part he had just gotten a memory key to unlock.
That part of him brought gods to their knees. He made kings and queens bow in surrounded.
His name alone was enough to strike fear in the hearts of immortals.
He had but one first name and no last name. He had no friends, no relatives and no romantic attachments.
He has no face, so nobody knows his true identity.
In all of his existence, his name and face were known only to one person, and that person was his mother.
Many called him the exterminator, the executioner, the grim reaper.
Those are just his nicknames.
His mother called him Dela, for that was the name she gave to him right after she fell to her death.
However, to the rest of the universe, they called him the Faceless Assassin.

chapters.title: Chapter 450: The Aftermath
paragraphs: There is something called a secret.
It’s something that is meant to remain hidden. It’s a secret for a reason.
So, when such secrets are made public, the backlash is always severe.
Pill Saint Enex had just been exposed, leaving him open to everyone’s criticism. He had indeed fallen into a deep one this time.
Kent made sure of it.
But while he made a clown out of Pill Saint Enex, he also ensured the other Saints knew they weren’t invincible.
He had unleashed his fury on them, and this time, they all knew that while many feared them, there was someone who wasn’t afraid of them.
Kent had proven to everyone he wasn’t afraid of them. This shows they are invincible regardless of what they think.
When he was done, he left, leaving them like idiots.
But that is the problem.
The aftermath of stuff like this isn’t always the best.
Though Kent spoke from a place he didn’t yet fully understand, he angered many, and because of that, he is now in everyone’s rearview.
But who can blame him?
What he knew of Pill Saint Enex, what he had done to Elaine, wasn’t something he could just swallow and let pass.
The quest he received told him all he had to know.
Apparently, the ambitious Saint wanted to become a Pill Sage. But in order to do that, he must first concoct a Tier 8 pill.
Pill Grandmasters can concoct Tier 3 to 5 pills, while Saints can do so from Tier 6 to 7.
So, just like how Kent had to concoct a Tier 3 pill as his requirement to become a Pill Grandmaster, Pill Saint Enex is required to concoct a Tier 8 pill.
However, there is a huge problem.

On the human continent, the highest pill recipe is at the Tier 7 stage. It was only known to a handful. This means the highest they can go is the Pill Saint stage since going to the Pill Empire, which is the elven empire, isn’t an option.
However, Pill Saint Enex had a fortuitous encounter while exploring the Ancient Battlefield of Parting. He discovered a Tier 8 pill recipe.
This was his breakthrough moment. Unfortunately, the recipe wasn’t a good one. It was a demonic pill that required a rather large quantity of life force to make.
This was a roadblock to him. He doesn’t have the magic to extract life force.
Life magic is rare, and while it’s not a combat-type magic, many cherish it. However, those who practice life magic are rather reclusive people.
However, somehow, Pill Saint Enex found out there was a family of life magic users in a certain village. This brought him some hope.
So he set out and managed to locate said family of magic users. However, after observing them for a while, he knew getting what he wanted would be difficult.
He saw how much Elaine and her family loved what they did. Of course, he set his sights on Elaine, who was the easiest to manipulate.
He knew, if he asked politely, there was no way she would come with him.
So, as sinister as he was, he formed the best plan.

He poisoned Elaine’s mother with a poison that life magic cannot heal. This calls for alchemy, and as sinister as he was, he made sure this was realized by the young life magic user who doesn’t know she is being manipulated.
It was safe to say she had indeed succeeded, and for years, he nurtured Elaine until he deemed her ripe enough for the picking.
That was when he approached her using that letter. Elaine became his, and when she finally accepted her role as the disciple of a Pill Saint, the real devil she had chosen bared his fangs at her.
She became helpless, and for years, she felt trapped.
But now, a stranger she planned to use as her shield has done more than she wanted. She just couldn’t understand what had happened or how it happened.
But she is now free.
However, Kent had just made himself into public enemy number one. His enemies started to increase, so he knew drastic measures must be taken.
He entered the carriage, where Nara and Lady Lani were already waiting for him. Soon, they are back to their hotel, which was being monitored like he left it.
The moment he entered the room, he called out.
"Sylara, come out."
The evil, undead lady appeared, frightening Lady Lani, who drew her dagger.
"Relax, Lady Lani, she is a friend," Kent said, using his left hand to block her from advancing toward her doom.
The red-eyed, undead lady looked at the assassin beauty but said nothing. But Kent could tell she was looking forward to torturing her.
"Master, you called me," Sylara said.
"Yes. Please keep an eye on that Pill Saint. The moment he took action to do anything stupid, kill him, and knowing you, do it slowly and painfully."
Kent said coldly, making the two ladies inside the room feel the temperature drop considerably.
"I will do as you say, Master." Sylara giggled, or made a sound that sounded like a giggle, and then vanished from the room.
"Nyxira, come out." Again, the Umbra Elf, who is also Elsa’s strongest soul sentinel, appeared. This again made the beautiful assassin turn and look at Nara, who just remained calm and watching.
"I know you can sense them, so go ahead and mark them all. When the time comes, they will be yours to kill. For now, we need them doing what they are doing."
Nyxira nodded and vanished. After she left, Kent turned and looked at the two ladies.
"We need to talk." Those words sounded very serious, so the ladies nodded, walked toward a dinner table, and sat down around it.
"What are we talking about?" Nara asked.
"Nothing serious if you are in my shoes, but apparently, the Forest Kings in the wild forest want me dead, and the reason is because of the Forest King I bought during the auction."
"What?" Lady Lani’s eyes widened hearing Kent. "Are you being serious?" she asked, and Kent nodded.
"They want me dead," he smiled. "But the thing is, I also want them dead, or perhaps alive." He smiled, but his expression turned evil.

"You see, in the next five years, this world might come to an end, and I am the only one that can save everyone. This means I want manpower. And while I will appreciate having them alive, I know that will be difficult to achieve, so I can only go for the next best option and use their dead bodies for my own project."
"Don’t tell me..." Lady Lani’s voice dropped as her jaw hung wide open.
